input.old_string:
\begin{abstract}
AI agents now orchestrate complex, multi-step activities across
hundreds of sessions in production deployments, and developers need
aggregate views to answer operational questions: where does the token
budget go by task category, where do failures concentrate, and which
workflows waste effort.
% AI 智能体如今在生产部署中编排跨数百个会话的复杂多步骤活动，开发者需要聚合视图来回答运维问题：token 预算按任务类别花在了哪里、故障集中在哪里、哪些工作流浪费了算力。
Existing observability tools provide per-session debugging views but
no cross-session profiling layer.
% 现有可观测性工具提供按会话的调试视图，但没有跨会话的 profiling 层。
The profiling methodology that answers these questions for traditional
software---fold identical call stacks into flame graphs---does not
directly apply because agent activities lack deterministic identifiers
and runtime call-stack hierarchies.
% 为传统软件回答这些问题的 profiling 方法论——将相同调用栈折叠为火焰图——不能直接适用，因为智能体活动缺乏确定性标识符和运行时调用栈层次。
We propose a semantic profiling model that adapts this methodology:
all activities are represented as uniform \emph{semantic operations},
\emph{intent attribution} derives deterministic labels from
natural-language fields, and \emph{profile projections} construct
aggregation hierarchies from field selections at query time.
% 我们提出一个语义 profiling 模型来适配此方法论：所有活动表示为统一的语义 operation，意图归因从自然语言字段派生确定性标签，profile 投影在查询时从字段选择构造聚合层次。
\sys implements this model as a profiler that compiles local agent
traces into pprof-compatible profiles with pluggable
intent-attribution backends.
% \sys 将此模型实现为一个 profiler，将本地智能体 trace 编译为 pprof 兼容的 profile，支持可插拔的意图归因后端。
On 325 real agent sessions, semantic profiling separates over 90\% of
system-effect weight that session-level views merge.
% 在 325 个真实智能体会话上，语义 profiling 分离了会话级视图所混合的超过 90\% 的系统副作用权重。
On four public datasets with hidden ground-truth labels
(34{,}539 operations), profiler-ranked groups localize labeled
problems at 9.4\% inspection cost versus flat summaries, with 45\%
fewer groups than fixed-session drilldown.
% 在四个具有隐藏真实标签的公开数据集（34,539 个操作）上，profiler 排序的分组以 9.4\% 的检查成本定位标注问题，比固定会话下钻减少 45\% 的分组数。
\end{abstract}

58	
59	%% ===================================================================
60	\section{Introduction}
61	\label{sec:intro}
62	
63	%% ¶1: Background + context
64	AI agents orchestrate multi-step activities that span two
65	layers: high-level intent (prompts, LLM calls, tool invocations) and
66	low-level system effects (process spawns, file and network I/O).
67	% AI 智能体编排跨越两层的多步骤活动：高层意图（提示词、LLM 调用、工具调用）和低层系统副作用（进程创建、文件和网络 I/O）。
68	As agents evolve from short, scripted workflows into complex systems
69	that run for hours, production teams accumulate hundreds of sessions
70	over weeks or months.
71	% 随着智能体从短小的脚本化工作流进化为运行数小时的复杂系统，生产团队在数周或数月内积累数百个会话。
72	
73	%% ¶2: Problem
74	However, no existing tool provides cross-session aggregate views by
75	semantic category.
76	% 然而，没有现有工具能按语义类别提供跨会话聚合视图。
77	Developers need to answer operational questions---which categories of
78	tasks consume the most token budget, where failures concentrate across
79	workflows, and which behavioral patterns trigger unsafe system
80	side-effects---but the only option today is manual inspection of
81	individual sessions.
82	% 开发者需要回答运维问题——哪类任务消耗最多 token 预算、故障跨工作流集中在哪里、哪些行为模式触发不安全系统副作用——但目前唯一的选择是逐个检查单个会话。
83	The gap is the distinction between debugging and profiling:
84	debugging inspects a single execution to find a fault, while
85	profiling aggregates across executions to answer ``where does the
86	cost go?''
87	% 这个缺口就是调试与 profiling 的区别：调试检查单次执行以定位故障，而 profiling 跨执行聚合以回答"开销花在了哪里？"
88	Agent observability today has only the debugging layer.
89	% 当今的智能体可观测性只有调试层。
90	
91	%% ¶3: Existing solutions
92	Existing agent observability tools do not fill this gap.
93	% 现有智能体可观测性工具没有填补此缺口。
94	LangSmith~\cite{langsmith}, Langfuse~\cite{langfuse},
95	Phoenix~\cite{phoenix}, and OpenTelemetry GenAI~\cite{otel} organize
96	events into per-session span trees, effective for diagnosing a single
97	run but unable to aggregate across sessions by semantic category.
98	% LangSmith~\cite{langsmith}、Langfuse~\cite{langfuse}、Phoenix~\cite{phoenix} 和 OpenTelemetry GenAI~\cite{otel} 将事件组织为按会话的 span 树，有效诊断单次运行但无法按语义类别跨会话聚合。
99	Datadog LLM Observability~\cite{datadog-llmobs} clusters user
100	messages by topic, and Laminar~\cite{laminar-signals} extracts
101	structured signals from traces, but both characterize \emph{input
102	distributions} (``30\% of users ask code questions'') rather than
103	\emph{resource attribution} (``review tasks consume 40\% of the
104	token budget''), because labels at the request level do not propagate
105	to downstream tool calls and system effects.
106	% Datadog LLM Observability~\cite{datadog-llmobs} 按主题聚类用户消息，Laminar~\cite{laminar-signals} 从 trace 中提取结构化信号，但两者都刻画输入分布（"30\% 的用户提问代码问题"）而非资源归因（"review 任务消耗了 40\% 的 token 预算"），因为请求级的标签不会传播到下游工具调用和系统副作用。
107	
108	%% ¶4: Root cause — why traditional profiling doesn't transfer directly
109	The profiling methodology is well-established for traditional
110	software.
111	% Profiling 方法论对传统软件已经成熟。
112	Flame graphs~\cite{flamegraphs} fold identical call stacks into a
113	single chart where width represents cost.
114	% 火焰图~\cite{flamegraphs}将相同调用栈折叠为一张图，宽度代表开销。
115	Two properties make this work: function names are deterministic, so
116	identical code paths always produce the same stack frames, and runtime
117	call nesting provides the aggregation hierarchy.
118	% 两个特性使其有效：函数名是确定性的，相同代码路径始终产生相同栈帧；运行时调用嵌套提供聚合层次。
119	Agent traces break both (\S\ref{sec:background}).
120	% 智能体 trace 两者都打破了（\S\ref{sec:background}）。
121	First, the core unit of agent work is a natural-language prompt, and
122	two prompts expressing the same intent share no common string;
123	framework-level span names (\texttt{LLMCall}, \texttt{ToolInvoke})
124	describe mechanisms, not semantic intent.
125	% 第一，智能体工作的核心单元是自然语言提示词，表达相同意图的两个提示词没有共同字符串；框架级 span 名称（\texttt{LLMCall}、\texttt{ToolInvoke}）描述机制，而非语义意图。
126	Second, agent events have no runtime call-stack hierarchy: prompts,
127	tool calls, and system effects are not nested by execution the way
128	function calls produce stack frames.
129	% 第二，智能体事件没有运行时调用栈层次：提示词、工具调用和系统副作用不像函数调用那样通过执行嵌套产生栈帧。
130	
131	%% ¶5: Model
132	Despite these differences, the fundamental profiling
133	methodology---define units, assign stable labels, construct
134	aggregation hierarchies, fold identical stacks---transfers to agent
135	traces.
136	% 尽管有这些差异，基本的 profiling 方法论——定义单元、赋予稳定标签、构造聚合层次、折叠相同栈——可以迁移到智能体 trace。
137	We propose a \emph{semantic profiling model} with three components.
138	% 我们提出一个包含三个组件的语义 profiling 模型。
139	\emph{Semantic operations} are uniform records with string fields and
140	additive measures that represent all agent activities---prompts, LLM
141	calls, tool invocations, and system effects---without type-specific
142	objects.
143	% 语义 operation 是带有字符串字段和可加度量的统一记录，表示所有智能体活动——提示词、LLM 调用、工具调用和系统副作用——无需特定类型对象。
144	\emph{Intent attribution} derives deterministic, low-cardinality
145	labels from natural-language fields, restoring the folding
146	precondition that CPU profiling obtains for free from function names.
147	% 意图归因从自然语言字段派生确定性、低基数的标签，恢复 CPU profiling 从函数名免费获得的折叠前提条件。
148	\emph{Profile projections} select an ordered list of fields at query
149	time to construct aggregation hierarchies, replacing the runtime call
150	stack.
151	% Profile 投影在查询时选择字段有序列表来构造聚合层次，替代运行时调用栈。
152	Different field selections answer different questions---by task
153	category, by execution phase, by session, by action type---from the
154	same data.
155	% 不同的字段选择从同一数据回答不同问题——按任务类别、按执行阶段、按会话、按操作类型。
156	
157	%% ¶6: This paper + system + results
158	We implement this model in \sys, an offline profiler that compiles
159	local agent traces into pprof-compatible profiles
160	(Figure~\ref{fig:architecture}).
161	% 我们在 \sys 中实现此模型，这是一个离线 profiler，将本地智能体 trace 编译为 pprof 兼容的 profile（Figure~\ref{fig:architecture}）。
162	Intent attribution supports pluggable backends: regex rules for
163	production use, a local LLM tagger for exploration, and unsupervised
164	clustering for bootstrapping.
165	% 意图归因支持可插拔后端：正则规则用于生产、本地 LLM 标注器用于探索、无监督聚类用于引导。
166	On 325 real Codex and Claude sessions (183{,}714 system observations),
167	semantic profiling separates over 90\% of system-effect weight that
168	session-level views merge.
169	% 在 325 个真实 Codex 和 Claude 会话（183,714 个系统观测）上，语义 profiling 分离了会话级视图所混合的超过 90\% 的系统副作用权重。
170	On four public datasets with hidden ground-truth labels
171	(34{,}539 operations), profiler-ranked groups localize labeled
172	problems at 9.4\% inspection cost versus flat summaries, with 45\%
173	fewer groups than fixed-session drilldown.
174	% 在四个具有隐藏真实标签的公开数据集（34,539 个操作）上，profiler 排序的分组以 9.4\% 的检查成本定位标注问题，比固定会话下钻减少 45\% 的分组数。
175	Label quality exceeds V-measure 0.7 on 7 of 9 held-out datasets.
176	% 标签质量在 9 个保留数据集中的 7 个上超过 V-measure 0.7。
177	
178	%% ¶7: Contributions
179	This paper makes three contributions:
180	% 本文做出三项贡献：
181	
182	\begin{enumerate}
183	\item \textbf{Profiling gap and semantic profiling model.}
184	  We identify the missing profiling layer in agent observability and
185	  propose a model covering semantic operations, intent attribution,
186	  and profile projections
187	  (\S\ref{sec:background}--\S\ref{sec:design}).
188	% 识别智能体可观测性中缺失的 profiling 层，提出涵盖语义 operation、意图归因和 profile 投影的模型。
189	\item \textbf{System: \sys.}
190	  A profiler that implements this model with pluggable intent
191	  attribution and pprof-compatible output (\S\ref{sec:impl}).
192	% 系统：\sys。实现此模型的 profiler，具有可插拔意图归因和 pprof 兼容输出。
193	\item \textbf{Hidden-label evaluation.}
194	  We evaluate profiler output against hidden ground-truth trajectory
195	  labels, analogous to injecting known bottlenecks in CPU profiler
196	  evaluation, on 325 real sessions and 4 public datasets
197	  (\S\ref{sec:eval}).
198	% 隐藏标签评估。将 profiler 输出与隐藏的真实轨迹标签评分，类似于在 CPU profiler 评估中注入已知瓶颈，在 325 个真实会话和 4 个公开数据集上验证。
199	\end{enumerate}
200	
201	%% ===================================================================
202	\section{Background and Motivation}
203	\label{sec:background}
204	
205	\subsection{AI Agent Observability}

tool calls, and system effects are not nested by execution the way
function calls produce stack frames.
% 第二，智能体事件没有运行时调用栈层次：提示词、工具调用和系统副作用不像函数调用那样通过执行嵌套产生栈帧。

aggregation hierarchies, fold identical stacks---transfers to agent
traces.

objects.

% 我们在 \sys 中实现此模型，这是一个离线 profiler，将本地智能体 trace 编译为 pprof 兼容的 profile（Figure~\ref{fig:architecture}）。

% 标签质量在 9 个保留数据集中的 7 个上超过 V-measure 0.7。

Reorganize the paper's existing abstract and introduction to match the venue's paragraph conventions. Start from what is on the page: reuse existing sentences wherever possible, move before rewriting, rewrite before inventing. Never invent claims, numbers, or insight wording.

% Datadog LLM Observability~\cite{datadog-llmobs} 按主题聚类用户消息，Laminar~\cite{laminar-signals} 从 trace 中提取结构化信号，但两者都刻画输入分布（"30\% 的用户提问代码问题"）而非资源归因（"review 任务消耗了 40\% 的 token 预算"），因为请求级的标签不会传播到下游工具调用和系统副作用。

%% ¶4: Root cause — why traditional profiling doesn't transfer directly
The profiling methodology is well-established for traditional
software.
% Profiling 方法论对传统软件已经成熟。
Flame graphs~\cite{flamegraphs} fold identical call stacks into a
single chart where width represents cost.
% 火焰图~\cite{flamegraphs}将相同调用栈折叠为一张图，宽度代表开销。
Two properties make this work: function names are deterministic, so
identical code paths always produce the same stack frames, and runtime
call nesting provides the aggregation hierarchy.
% 两个特性使其有效：函数名是确定性的，相同代码路径始终产生相同栈帧；运行时调用嵌套提供聚合层次。
Agent traces break both (\S\ref{sec:background}).
% 智能体 trace 两者都打破了（\S\ref{sec:background}）。
First, the core unit of agent work is a natural-language prompt, and
two prompts expressing the same intent share no common string;
framework-level span names (\texttt{LLMCall}, \texttt{ToolInvoke})
describe mechanisms, not semantic intent.
% 第一，智能体工作的核心单元是自然语言提示词，表达相同意图的两个提示词没有共同字符串；框架级 span 名称（\texttt{LLMCall}、\texttt{ToolInvoke}）描述机制，而非语义意图。
Second, agent events have no runtime call-stack hierarchy: prompts,
tool calls, and system effects are not nested by execution the way
function calls produce stack frames.
% 第二，智能体事件没有运行时调用栈层次：提示词、工具调用和系统副作用不像函数调用那样通过执行嵌套产生栈帧。

%% ¶5: Model
Despite these differences, the fundamental profiling
methodology---define units, assign stable labels, construct
aggregation hierarchies, fold identical stacks---transfers to agent
traces.
% 尽管有这些差异，基本的 profiling 方法论——定义单元、赋予稳定标签、构造聚合层次、折叠相同栈——可以迁移到智能体 trace。
We propose a \emph{semantic profiling model} with three components.
% 我们提出一个包含三个组件的语义 profiling 模型。
\emph{Semantic operations} are uniform records with string fields and
additive measures that represent all agent activities---prompts, LLM
calls, tool invocations, and system effects---without type-specific
objects.
% 语义 operation 是带有字符串字段和可加度量的统一记录，表示所有智能体活动——提示词、LLM 调用、工具调用和系统副作用——无需特定类型对象。
\emph{Intent attribution} derives deterministic, low-cardinality
labels from natural-language fields, restoring the folding
precondition that CPU profiling obtains for free from function names.
% 意图归因从自然语言字段派生确定性、低基数的标签，恢复 CPU profiling 从函数名免费获得的折叠前提条件。
\emph{Profile projections} select an ordered list of fields at query
time to construct aggregation hierarchies, replacing the runtime call
stack.
% Profile 投影在查询时选择字段有序列表来构造聚合层次，替代运行时调用栈。
Different field selections answer different questions---by task
category, by execution phase, by session, by action type---from the
same data.
% 不同的字段选择从同一数据回答不同问题——按任务类别、按执行阶段、按会话、按操作类型。

%% ¶6: This paper + system + results
We implement this model in \sys, an offline profiler that compiles
local agent traces into pprof-compatible profiles

75	% 随着智能体从短小的脚本化工作流进化为运行数小时的复杂系统，生产团队在数周或数月内积累数百个会话。
76	
77	%% ¶2: Problem
78	To improve agent quality, safety, and cost efficiency, developers
79	need to analyze operational behavior across sessions to determine
80	which categories of tasks consume the most token budget, where
81	failures concentrate across workflows, and which behavioral patterns
82	trigger unsafe system side-effects.
83	% 为了提高智能体质量、安全性和成本效率，开发者需要跨会话分析运维行为：哪类任务消耗最多 token 预算、故障跨工作流集中在哪里、哪些行为模式触发不安全系统副作用。
84	Systems observability has long distinguished this kind of aggregate
85	analysis (profiling) from single-execution debugging.
86	% 系统可观测性早已将这种聚合分析（profiling）与单次执行调试区分开来。
87	Agent observability today has only the debugging layer.
88	% 当今的智能体可观测性只有调试层。
89	
90	%% ¶3: Existing solutions
91	Existing agent observability tools do not fill this gap.
92	% 现有智能体可观测性工具没有填补此缺口。
93	LangSmith~\cite{langsmith}, Langfuse~\cite{langfuse},
94	Phoenix~\cite{phoenix}, and OpenTelemetry GenAI~\cite{otel} organize
95	events into per-session span trees, effective for diagnosing a single
96	run but unable to aggregate across sessions by semantic category.
97	% LangSmith~\cite{langsmith}、Langfuse~\cite{langfuse}、Phoenix~\cite{phoenix} 和 OpenTelemetry GenAI~\cite{otel} 将事件组织为按会话的 span 树，有效诊断单次运行但无法按语义类别跨会话聚合。
98	Datadog LLM Observability~\cite{datadog-llmobs} clusters user
99	messages by topic, and Laminar~\cite{laminar-signals} extracts
100	structured signals from traces, but both characterize \emph{input
101	distributions} (``30\% of users ask code questions'') rather than
102	\emph{resource attribution} (``review tasks consume 40\% of the
103	token budget''), because labels at the request level do not propagate
104	to downstream tool calls and system effects.
105	% Datadog LLM Observability~\cite{datadog-llmobs} 按主题聚类用户消息，Laminar~\cite{laminar-signals} 从 trace 中提取结构化信号，但两者都刻画输入分布（"30\% 的用户提问代码问题"）而非资源归因（"review 任务消耗了 40\% 的 token 预算"），因为请求级的标签不会传播到下游工具调用和系统副作用。
106	
107	%% ¶4: Root cause — why traditional profiling doesn't transfer directly
108	The profiling methodology is well-established for traditional
109	software.
110	% Profiling 方法论对传统软件已经成熟。
111	Flame graphs~\cite{flamegraphs} fold identical call stacks into a
112	single chart where width represents cost.
113	% 火焰图~\cite{flamegraphs}将相同调用栈折叠为一张图，宽度代表开销。
114	Two properties make this work: function names are deterministic, so
115	identical code paths always produce the same stack frames, and runtime
116	call nesting provides the aggregation hierarchy.
117	% 两个特性使其有效：函数名是确定性的，相同代码路径始终产生相同栈帧；运行时调用嵌套提供聚合层次。
118	Agent traces break both (\S\ref{sec:background}).
119	% 智能体 trace 两者都打破了（\S\ref{sec:background}）。
120	First, the core unit of agent work is a natural-language prompt, and
121	two prompts expressing the same intent share no common string;
122	framework-level span names (\texttt{LLMCall}, \texttt{ToolInvoke})
123	describe mechanisms, not semantic intent.
124	% 第一，智能体工作的核心单元是自然语言提示词，表达相同意图的两个提示词没有共同字符串；框架级 span 名称（\texttt{LLMCall}、\texttt{ToolInvoke}）描述机制，而非语义意图。
125	Second, agent events have no runtime call-stack hierarchy: prompts,
126	tool calls, and system effects are not nested by execution the way
127	function calls produce stack frames.
128	% 第二，智能体事件没有运行时调用栈层次：提示词、工具调用和系统副作用不像函数调用那样通过执行嵌套产生栈帧。
129	
130	%% ¶5: Model
131	Despite these differences, the fundamental profiling
132	methodology (define units, assign stable labels, construct
133	aggregation hierarchies, fold identical stacks) transfers to agent
134	traces.
135	% 尽管有这些差异，基本的 profiling 方法论——定义单元、赋予稳定标签、构造聚合层次、折叠相同栈——可以迁移到智能体 trace。
136	We propose a \emph{semantic profiling model} with three components.
137	% 我们提出一个包含三个组件的语义 profiling 模型。
138	\emph{Semantic operations} are uniform records with string fields and
139	additive measures that represent all agent activities (prompts, LLM
140	calls, tool invocations, and system effects) without type-specific
141	objects.
142	% 语义 operation 是带有字符串字段和可加度量的统一记录，表示所有智能体活动——提示词、LLM 调用、工具调用和系统副作用——无需特定类型对象。
143	\emph{Intent attribution} derives deterministic, low-cardinality
144	labels from natural-language fields, restoring the folding
145	precondition that CPU profiling obtains for free from function names.
146	% 意图归因从自然语言字段派生确定性、低基数的标签，恢复 CPU profiling 从函数名免费获得的折叠前提条件。
147	\emph{Profile projections} select an ordered list of fields at query
148	time to construct aggregation hierarchies, replacing the runtime call
149	stack.
150	% Profile 投影在查询时选择字段有序列表来构造聚合层次，替代运行时调用栈。
151	Different field selections answer different questions (by task category, by execution phase, by session, or by
152	action type) from the same data.
153	% 不同的字段选择从同一数据回答不同问题——按任务类别、按执行阶段、按会话、按操作类型。
154

content.text:
Base directory for this skill: /home/yunwei37/.claude/skills/check-terminology-infoflow

# Terminology & Information Flow Audit

Audit the LaTeX file at `/home/yunwei37/workspace/agentsight-research-semantic-flamegraph/docs/agentpprof-paper/main.tex intro` for terminology consistency, invented jargon, concept coherence, and cross-section information flow. If no argument is given, ask which file to audit.

This skill catches **deep readability problems** that sentence-level style checking misses. The root cause of "reads hard" is usually not punctuation but: (a) reader encounters a term they don't know, (b) the same idea uses different words in different places, (c) a paragraph repeats what an earlier section already said, or (d) the logical thread (old → new) breaks.

## Process

1. Read the entire file
2. Build a **concept inventory**: list every technical term, its definition location, and all use locations
3. Run checks in order: Jargon (J) → Consistency (C) → Information Flow (F) → Cross-section (X)
4. Report issues grouped by severity: **Must fix** (reader cannot understand), **Should fix** (reader confused or slowed), **Consider** (polish)
5. Apply fixes directly — Must fix first, then Should fix, then evaluate each Consider. Do not ask the user; do not silently discard Should-fix items. Exception: when invoked read-only as a review subagent, report only.

## Editing discipline

- **Minimal targeted changes only.** Never rewrite, restructure, or delete existing content unless explicitly asked.
- **NEVER delete design decisions or technical content.**
- **NEVER change the meaning** of a sentence. If unsure, flag instead of editing.
- **Preserve scope-bearing hedges** (`in our setting`, `on the selected subset`).
- **System name via `\sys` macro only.** Flag hardcoded system name as Must-fix.
- **Verify before claiming done** — recompile LaTeX, check it builds.

---

## J: Jargon & Invented Terms (check FIRST — highest impact)

Invented jargon is the single biggest cause of "reads hard." AI-drafted and project-internal prose coins compound nouns that look professional but no reviewer recognizes.

### J1: The reviewer test (P0)

For every compound technical noun (2+ words used as a term of art), ask: **"Would a reviewer at this venue recognize this term without our paper defining it?"**

- YES → keep (e.g., "flame graph", "span tree", "call stack")
- NO, but this paper formally introduces it → keep if defined at first use with motivation
- NO, and it just appeared → **Must fix.** Replace with plain language or the field's standard term.

**Grep for candidates:**
```bash
# Find capitalized or hyphenated compound nouns that might be invented
grep -onE '[A-Z][a-z]+-[A-Z][a-z]+|[a-z]+-[a-z]+ [a-z]+' file.tex | sort -u
```

**Red flags:**
- Compound appears exactly once with no definition
- Term cannot be found in the paper's own related work or cited papers
- Reader would ask "X 是啥?" and author needs >1 sentence to explain
- Term is a workflow/project artifact name leaking into prose (run IDs, script names, internal metric names)

**Common AI-drafting inventions to watch for:**
- `*-aware` compounds ("query-aware", "label-aware") — OK if defined; flag if used without definition
- `*-level` qualifiers — often redundant (see J2)
- `*-derived` / `*-based` chains — check if the base concept is defined
- Internal process vocabulary: "artifact ledger", "run ledger", "source-status", "hygiene check", "gate", "reviewer packet"

### J2: Redundant qualifiers

| Often redundant | Usually needed |
|-----------------|----------------|
| system-level (just "system") | OS-level (vs tool-level) |
| kernel-level (just "kernel") | intent-level (vs syscall-level) |
| execution-level (just "execution") | category-level (vs span-level) |

**Test:** does removing `-level` / `-based` / `-driven` lose meaning? If not, drop it.

### J3: Project vocabulary leaking into paper prose (P0)

Paper prose must not read like a project report, README, or experiment log. Check for:
- Run IDs, script names, output paths ("R320", "run_rq2.sh")
- Internal metric names not defined in the paper ("prevalence/group-size null")
- Tool-specific configuration vocabulary ("profile-spec patches", "rank-feature rows", "guided repairs")
- Evaluation-internal shorthand never explained to the reader ("label-drilldown", "boundary-derived fields", "visible-risk ranker")
- Status-update language ("we then ran...", "the next step was...")
- Implementation-detail nouns used as concepts ("profile spec", "mapping rule") without explaining what they mean to a reader who has not seen the codebase

**Test:** could you submit this sentence to a reviewer who has never seen your repo? If they'd need access to your codebase to understand it, rewrite.

**Especially in evaluation sections:** every metric name, baseline name, policy name, and configuration shorthand that appears in a table or prose must be either (a) a term the community already uses, or (b) defined in the paper before first use. If a table says "op-stack:query-aware" and the body says "operation-stack query-aware profiling", the reader must not have to guess these are the same thing.

### J4: Section and RQ titles must use reader language (P0)

Section titles, subsection titles, and research-question names are the first thing a reviewer reads. They must use the reader's vocabulary, not internal methodology terms.

**Check:** for each `\section` and `\subsection` title, ask: "Would a reviewer who has not read the paper body understand what this section is about from the title alone?"

**Common violations:**
- RQ title describes the evaluation method instead of the question the reader cares about ("Can X Localize Hidden Labeled Problems?" → the reader cares "Does X Find Real Problems?", not about your hidden-label methodology)
- Title uses paper-internal compound nouns ("flat views", "mixed-intent buckets", "derived labels") that the reader has not seen defined yet
- Title uses nested relative clauses that are hard to parse ("Does X Separate What Y Mix?" — three concepts in one clause)

**Fix:** rewrite the title to state the question in plain language that any reviewer at the target venue would understand without reading the body. The methodology belongs in the body text, not the title.

**Bad:** `RQ2: Can Profiler Groups Localize Hidden Labeled Problems?`
**Good:** `RQ2: Does Profiler Output Correspond to Real Problems?`

### J5: Term overloading (same word, two meanings) (P0)

If the same word is used for two distinct concepts, the reader cannot tell which meaning is intended.

**Check:** for each high-frequency term, list all the meanings it carries. If >1, either rename one or add a qualifying adjective at every use.

**Common overloads to watch for:**
- "label" = semantic tag assigned by intent recognition AND ground-truth annotation from a benchmark
- "stack" = operation stack (this paper's abstraction) AND call stack (CPU profiling concept)
- "view" = the formal triple $(\varphi, \sigma, w)$ AND a loose synonym for "perspective"
- "operation" = the record type AND a loose synonym for "action"

**Fix:** add a qualifier ("semantic label" vs "ground-truth label", "operation stack" vs "call stack") or pick different words for different concepts.

### J6: Audience calibration

Terms that are standard at one venue may need definition at another. Before reviewing, identify the target venue and its community.

**Check:** for each technical term from a neighboring field, ask "would a typical reviewer at this venue know this term?" If uncertain, add a one-clause definition at first use.

**Examples:**
- OS venue readers may not know "span tree", "LLM call", "token budget" without brief explanation
- ML venue readers may not know "eBPF", "uprobe", "call stack" without context
- Workshop papers have a broader audience range than main conferences

---

## C: Consistency (same concept → same term)

### C1: Synonym drift (P0)

Grep for near-synonyms of every key concept. If the same concept uses multiple terms, unify to one.

```bash
# Example: check if "label" and "tag" are used interchangeably
grep -onE '\b(label|tag|annotation|marker)\b' file.tex | sort | uniq -c
```

**Common drift pairs to check (adapt to paper's domain):**
- label / tag / annotation / marker
- policy / rule / constraint / directive
- view / projection / aggregation / summary
- record / entry / event / sample / operation
- harness / runtime / framework / system
- merge / fold / aggregate / combine / collapse

For each pair found: are they genuinely distinct concepts? If yes, ensure the distinction is stated. If no, pick one and replace all instances of the other.

### C2: Defined-before-used (P0)

Every technical term, acronym, and notation must be **defined before first use**, including in:
- Abstract (readers start here)
- Figure/table captions (readers hit these out of order)
- Section headers

**Check method:** for each technical term, find (a) definition location and (b) first use location. If (b) < (a), it's a Must-fix.

### C3: Compound adjective hyphenation

Compound adjectives before nouns need hyphens; standalone uses do not.

| Before noun (hyphenate) | After verb (no hyphen) |
|---|---|
| cross-session aggregation | aggregate across sessions |
| query-time projection | chosen at query time |
| single-run debugging | debug a single run |
| intent-derived labels | labels derived from intent |

```bash
grep -onE '(cross|query|single|intent|system|per|multi)[- ](session|time|run|derived|effect|layer|view)' file.tex | sort | uniq -c
```

### C4: Spelling variants

Pick one and enforce consistency:
- runtime vs run-time
- predefined vs pre-defined  
- subagent vs sub-agent
- dataset vs data set
- backend vs back-end

### C5: Capitalization

Check proper nouns and acronyms for consistency:
```bash
grep -oE '(eBPF|EBPF|ebpf|GitHub|Github|macOS|MacOS)' file.tex | sort | uniq -c
```

### C6: Notation and symbol consistency

Math symbols and formal notation must be used identically wherever they appear. If $\varphi$ is defined as a predicate in §3, do not switch to the word "predicate" without the symbol elsewhere, or use a different symbol for the same concept.

**Check:** list every math symbol defined in the paper. For each, grep for (a) the symbol and (b) its plain-text synonym. If the paper alternates between symbol and text for the same concept, unify.

```bash
grep -n 'varphi\|predicate\|filter' file.tex | head -20
```

### C7: Figure/table caption terms match body text

Readers often read captions before body text. If a caption uses a different term or abbreviation than the body, the reader must guess whether they mean the same thing.

**Check:** for each figure/table, compare the terms in the caption with the terms used in the paragraph that references it.

**Common mismatches:**
- Caption says "Mixed wt.%" but body says "mixed-intent weight percentage"
- Caption says "R@5" but body says "top-five recall" with no definition of the abbreviation
- Caption uses a short form ("op-stack") that body never introduces

**Fix:** either define the short form in the caption ("op-stack = operation-stack") or use the full term.

---

## F: Information Flow (within paragraphs)

### F1: Topic sentence test

The **first sentence** of every paragraph should state the paragraph's main claim or topic. If the first sentence is an example, definition, or subsidiary detail, the paragraph lacks a topic sentence.

**Check:** read only the first sentence of each paragraph in sequence. Do they tell the paper's story? If not, the topic sentences are missing or misplaced.

### F2: Old → new thread (Gopen & Swan)

Each sentence should **begin with something the reader already knows** (backward link) and **end with the new information** (stress position).

**Bad:** `A 40% reduction in latency results from label caching.`
- "A 40% reduction" is new — reader doesn't know what to anchor it to
**Good:** `Label caching reduces latency by 40%.`
- "Label caching" is known; "40%" is the new, stressed information

**Systematic check:** for each sentence, is the subject something mentioned in the previous sentence or established context? If the sentence introduces a completely new subject with no backward link, it breaks the thread.

### F3: Why before what

Every design decision must state its **motivation before the mechanism**. If a sentence describes what the system does without first saying why, the reader lacks context.

**Pattern:** "Because [problem/need], [mechanism]." or "[Problem]. [Mechanism] solves this by [how]."

**Bad:** `\sys uses a single abstraction.` (what, no why)
**Good:** `Because agent activities span both layers, \sys uses a single abstraction.` (why, then what)

### F4: Claim before evidence

In evaluation paragraphs, state **what the numbers mean** before giving the numbers. The reader should know why the data matters before seeing the data.

**Bad:** `217 (36%) have one clause. 231 (38%) have two.` (data dump)
**Good:** `Most policies are structurally simple: 74% have at most two clauses.` (claim, then evidence)

### F5: One idea per paragraph

Each paragraph should contain exactly one main point. If a paragraph covers two unrelated ideas, split it. If the same idea spans two paragraphs without a clear progression, merge.

### F6: Logical connectors between sentences

Sentences within a paragraph must signal their logical relationship (contrast, consequence, elaboration, addition). Bare juxtaposition forces the reader to guess the connection.

**Check:** read consecutive sentence pairs. Is the relationship explicit ("because", "however", "therefore", ", so", ", and") or left implicit? Two implicit transitions in a row is a Should-fix.

### F7: Example before abstraction (concrete before abstract)

Show a concrete scenario before the abstract generalization, so the reader has an anchor. "Once the reader has the intuition, they can follow the details." (SPJ)

**Bad:** `An operation stack is an ordered list of fields. For example, [session, prompt_tag, kind] produces...`
**Good:** `A developer asking 'which task categories consume the most tokens?' needs session, prompt_tag, and kind as the grouping axes. An operation stack formalizes this as an ordered field list.`

### F8: Concept dependency order

Concepts should be introduced in **dependency order**: if understanding B requires A, define A first. This goes beyond C2 (defined-before-used for terms) — it applies to the conceptual building blocks.

**Check:** draw the dependency graph of the paper's key concepts. Is the prose order a topological sort of this graph? If the reader must hold an undefined concept in working memory to understand the current paragraph, reorder.

**Example:** if "operation stack" depends on "operation" and "intent recognition", then §Operations must precede §Operation Stacks, and both must precede any section that combines them.

### F9: Evaluation methodology clarity

Every RQ/experiment must answer four questions **before presenting results**. If any is missing, the reader sees numbers without understanding what they mean.

1. **What claim is being tested?** ("We test whether semantic labels separate system-effect weight that flat views mix.")
2. **What is the setup?** (Data, baselines, configuration — in concrete terms the reader can picture.)
3. **What is the procedure?** (What did you do, step by step, in 2-3 sentences? "We hide ground-truth labels, run the profiler, rank the resulting groups, and check whether top groups contain hidden positives.")
4. **What metric answers the question?** (Define every metric before using it. "Mixed-weight percentage: the fraction of system-effect weight in buckets containing observations from multiple semantic regions.")

**Common failures:**
- RQ jumps from setup directly to results, skipping the procedure
- Metric abbreviations appear in tables (AP, R@5, WTFP) without definition in prose
- Baselines are named but not described ("fixed-session:query-aware" — what does this do?)
- Configuration names in tables don't match prose descriptions ("op-stack" vs "operation-stack")
- Numbers are presented without stating what they mean: "AP = 0.312" without saying whether that's good or bad, and compared to what

**Test for each RQ:** after reading the RQ section, could a reviewer reproduce the experiment from the description alone (minus implementation details)? If not, the methodology is unclear.

---

## X: Cross-Section Coherence

### X1: Redundancy detection (Should fix)

Check whether any paragraph **repeats content from a different section** nearly verbatim. Common offenders:
- Design section repeating Background definitions
- Evaluation section re-explaining the design
- Related work re-stating the problem from the intro

**Grep method:**
```bash
# Find sentences that share long n-grams across sections
grep -n 'distinctive phrase from section A' file.tex
```

If a section needs to reference content from another section, use a forward/backward reference (`as described in §X`) rather than repeating.

### X2: Claim-evidence alignment

For each claim in the introduction/abstract, verify:
1. The claim has corresponding evidence in the evaluation
2. The evidence section references the correct claim
3. Numbers in abstract/intro match numbers in evaluation tables

### X3: Term stability across sections

Check that key terms defined in one section are used **identically** (same spelling, same hyphenation, same capitalization) in all other sections.

```bash
# Check a key term across the paper
grep -n 'operation stack\|operation-stack\|Operation Stack\|OperationStack' file.tex
```

### X4: Declare system status upfront

Do not bury "this is a prototype" or "this is future work" at the end. State explicitly whether the system is fully implemented, a prototype, or hypothetical, so reviewers know what they are evaluating. (Levin & Redell)

### X5: Cite by author

Use "Smith et al.~[5] show..." rather than "[5] shows..." for readability and proper credit. Place the citation near the author name.

**Bad:** `[5] shows that flame graphs reduce debugging time.`
**Good:** `Gregg~[5] shows that flame graphs reduce debugging time.`

### X6: Numbers are claims

Every number in the paper needs a source (measurement, citation, or derivation). For experimental numbers, state repetitions, duration, object sizes, and hardware where applicable.

### X7: Forward reference cost audit

Each forward reference ("§3 will describe...", "we detail this in §5") asks the reader to hold an IOU in working memory. Too many IOUs and the reader loses trust.

**Check:** count forward references. More than 3-4 in the intro or more than 2 per body section is a warning sign. For each one, ask: does the reader **need** this promise to follow the current paragraph? If not, delete the forward reference and let the reader discover the section naturally from the paper structure.

---

## Output format

For each issue found:
```
L<line>: "<quoted text>"
  Category: J1/C2/F3/X1/etc.
  Problem: <what's wrong and why the reader is confused>
  Fix: "<suggested rewrite>"
```

Group by severity (Must fix → Should fix → Consider), then by category within each group.

End with:
- Summary table: issues by category and severity
- Top 3 most impactful changes (the ones that most improve readability)
- Any patterns observed (e.g., "project vocabulary leaks concentrated in §5")

After all fixes, recompile and verify page count unchanged.

\begin{abstract}
AI agents orchestrate multi-step activities across hundreds of
sessions, but existing observability tools provide only per-session
debugging views with no cross-session profiling layer.
% AI 智能体跨数百个会话编排多步骤活动，但现有可观测性工具仅提供按会话的调试视图，没有跨会话的 profiling 层。
To improve quality, safety, and cost efficiency, developers need
aggregate analysis of which task categories consume the most budget,
where failures concentrate, and which workflows trigger unsafe
side-effects, but today the only option is manual inspection of
individual sessions.
% 为了提高质量、安全性和成本效率，开发者需要聚合分析哪类任务消耗最多预算、故障集中在哪里、哪些工作流触发不安全副作用，但目前唯一的选择是逐个检查单个会话。
The flame-graph profiling methodology that answers these questions for
traditional software does not directly apply because agent traces lack
deterministic identifiers and runtime call-stack hierarchies.
% 为传统软件回答这些问题的火焰图 profiling 方法论不能直接适用，因为智能体 trace 缺乏确定性标识符和运行时调用栈层次。
We propose a \emph{semantic profiling model} that adapts this
methodology: uniform \emph{semantic operations} represent all
activities, \emph{intent attribution} derives deterministic labels
from natural-language fields, and \emph{profile projections} construct
aggregation hierarchies from field selections at query time.
% 我们提出一个语义 profiling 模型来适配此方法论：统一的语义 operation 表示所有活动，意图归因从自然语言字段派生确定性标签，profile 投影在查询时从字段选择构造聚合层次。
\sys implements this model as a profiler that compiles local agent
traces into pprof-compatible profiles with pluggable
intent-attribution backends.
% \sys 将此模型实现为一个 profiler，将本地智能体 trace 编译为 pprof 兼容的 profile，支持可插拔的意图归因后端。
On 325 real agent sessions, semantic profiling separates over 90\% of
system-effect weight that session-level views merge.
% 在 325 个真实智能体会话上，语义 profiling 分离了会话级视图所混合的超过 90\% 的系统副作用权重。
On four public datasets with hidden ground-truth labels
(34{,}539 operations), profiler-ranked groups localize labeled
problems at 9.4\% inspection cost versus flat summaries, with 45\%
fewer groups than fixed-session drilldown.
% 在四个具有隐藏真实标签的公开数据集（34,539 个操作）上，profiler 排序的分组以 9.4\% 的检查成本定位标注问题，比固定会话下钻减少 45\% 的分组数。

---

## 术语与信息流审计：Intro 部分

### Must fix

**1. J5 / C1：intro 和 body 术语断裂（最严重的问题）**

Intro ¶5 引入了三个模型组件：
- **semantic operations**（2 次，仅出现在 intro + abstract）
- **intent attribution**（2 次，仅 intro + abstract）
- **profile projections**（2 次，仅 intro + abstract）

但 §3 Design 和 §5 Evaluation 全文使用的是**完全不同的术语**：
- **operations** / `\operation`（12+ 次）
- **intent recognition**（4 次）
- **operation stacks** / `\opstack`（14 次）

读者在 intro 里学了三个概念名，翻到 §3 发现全换了一套。这是**最影响可读性的问题**——读者不确定 "intent attribution" 和 "intent recognition" 是不是同一个东西，"profile projection" 和 "operation stack" 是不是同一个东西。

**修法：** 必须统一。两个方向：
- (A) 把 §3 的术语改成 intro 的（semantic operation / intent attribution / profile projection）
- (B) 把 intro 改回 §3 的术语（operation / intent recognition / operation stack）

建议 **(A)**，因为 intro 的术语更 self-explanatory、更能过 J1 reviewer test。但这涉及全文改动，不在本次 scope 内。先标记，后续处理。

**2. J5：`label` 严重 overloaded**

`label` 在论文里至少有三个含义：
- **semantic label**：intent attribution 产生的标签（如 `review`, `debug`）
- **ground-truth label**：公开数据集里的隐藏真实标签（用于评估）
- **LaTeX label**：`\label{sec:...}`（不影响读者，忽略）

Intro ¶6 line 165 "semantic profiling separates over 90\% of system-effect weight" 和 ¶6 line 168 "hidden ground-truth labels" 紧挨着出现，但没有区分。Abstract S3 说 "derives deterministic labels" 而 S6 说 "hidden ground-truth labels"——同一段里 `label` 的两个含义。

**修法：** 用 qualifier 区分。semantic label / ground-truth label。至少在首次出现时加限定词。

---

### Should fix

**3. C1：`system effect` vs `side-effect` 同义漂移**

- Abstract S2: "unsafe **side-effects**"
- Intro ¶1 line 70: "low-level **system effects**"
- Intro ¶2 line 82: "unsafe system **side-effects**"
- Abstract S5: "**system-effect** weight"
- Intro ¶6 line 165: "**system-effect** weight"

`system effect` 和 `side-effect` 交替使用，有时还出现 `system side-effect` 这个混合形式。读者不确定它们是否是同一个概念。

**修法：** 统一为 `system effect`（论文的技术含义：agent 触发的进程/文件/网络操作）。"side-effect" 有 "不想要的" 含义，但论文里这些 effect 不一定是不想要的，它们是 profiling 的对象。在 ¶2 中 "unsafe system side-effects" 可以改为 "unsafe system effects"。

**4. F2：Abstract S5 "system-effect weight that session-level views merge" 句子难读**

"separates over 90\% of system-effect weight that session-level views merge" ——这个 relative clause 的方向反了。读者要到句末才知道 "merge" 的主语是 session-level views。

**修法：** "semantic profiling separates over 90\% of system-effect weight that session-level views leave mixed" 或更直接："session-level views mix 90\% of system-effect weight into undifferentiated buckets; semantic profiling separates it."

**5. J6：Audience calibration — `pprof`, `flame graph`, `span tree` 对 workshop audience**

AgenticOS workshop 的 audience 是 OS 研究者。他们大概率知道 flame graph 和 profiling，但可能不熟悉：
- `span tree`（OpenTelemetry 概念）
- `pprof`（Go 工具生态的特定工具名）
- `token budget`（LLM 计费概念）

Intro ¶3 里 "per-session span trees" 没有解释 span tree 是什么。对于 OS 读者，一句 "hierarchical trace representations" 或者 "(hierarchical execution traces)" 作为补充会有帮助。

**6. F7：¶5 模型段缺少 concrete-before-abstract**

¶5 直接跳到抽象定义（"semantic operations are uniform records with string fields..."）。读者还没有具体直觉就遇到了形式化描述。

一个 1 句的具体例子会大幅改善——比如："A developer asking 'which task categories consume the most tokens?' needs a profiling view that groups by task, not by session."——然后再说模型。

但考虑到 workshop 6 页的空间限制，这是 Consider 级别，不是 Must fix。

---

### Consider

**7. C2：¶4 "fold identical stacks" 在 abstract 和 ¶5 出现，但在首次出现（abstract line 37）时未定义**

"flame-graph methodology" 和 "fold identical call stacks" 在 abstract S3 第一次出现。读者如果不知道 flame graph 是什么，这一句就是不透明的。但考虑到 target venue 是 SOSP workshop，OS 读者大概率知道 flame graph。可以不改。

**8. X1：¶1 和 §2.1 开头冗余**

Intro ¶1: "AI agents orchestrate multi-step activities that span two layers: high-level intent... and low-level system effects..."
§2.1 line 204: "AI agents orchestrate heterogeneous activities that span two layers: (1)~high-level intent... and (2)~low-level system effects..."

几乎完全重复。§2.1 可以用 "As introduced in §1, agent activities span two layers" 一笔带过，不需要重述。

---

### 总结表

| 类别 | 严重度 | 数量 |
|------|--------|------|
| J5 术语断裂（intro vs body） | Must fix | 1（影响全文） |
| J5 label overloaded | Must fix | 1 |
| C1 system effect/side-effect | Should fix | 1 |
| F2 abstract 句子可读性 | Should fix | 1 |
| J6 audience calibration | Should fix | 1 |
| F7 缺 concrete example | Consider | 1 |
| C2 fold 未定义 | Consider | 1 |
| X1 ¶1/§2.1 冗余 | Consider | 1 |

### Top 3 最有影响力的改动

1. **统一 intro 和 body 的术语**（semantic operation ↔ operation, intent attribution ↔ intent recognition, profile projection ↔ operation stack）——这是读者 "读不懂" 的最大原因
2. **区分 semantic label 和 ground-truth label**——消除 overloading
3. **统一 system effect / side-effect**——消除同义漂移

对，Intent attribution 是一个**算法框架/接口**，不是一个具体算法。让我重新整理：

## Model

**Semantic operation stack model**：
- **Semantic operation**：统一记录（单元）
- **Operation stack**：查询时字段投影构造的层次（聚合结构）
- 模型的前提：operation 的字段必须是确定性、低基数、可聚合的，才能 fold

## Algorithm Framework: Intent Attribution

模型说 "需要确定性标签"，intent attribution 是**填这个 slot 的算法框架**——一个可插拔的接口，下面挂多种具体算法：

| 具体算法 | 输入 | 输出 | 适用场景 |
|---------|------|------|---------|
| Regex rules | prompt 文本 | 单词标签 | 生产环境，已知 pattern |
| Local LLM tagger | prompt 文本 | 单词标签 | 探索，多语言，复杂 prompt |
| Unsupervised clustering | prompt 向量 | 聚类 ID | 冷启动，发现自然分组 |
| Mapping rules | 已有字段 | 派生字段 | 结构化数据集（无 NL） |
| Boundary predictor | 相邻 operation 对 | 边界标记 | 人工任务分割 |

所以层次是：

```
Model: semantic operation stack model
  ├── semantic operations（数据模型）
  └── operation stacks（聚合机制）
          └── 前提：确定性标签
                └── Intent Attribution（算法框架/接口）
                      ├── regex rules
                      ├── LLM tagger  
                      ├── clustering
                      ├── mapping rules
                      └── boundary predictor
```

- ¶5（model）：介绍 semantic operation stack model，说明 fold 需要确定性标签
- ¶6（system）：说 \sys 通过 pluggable intent attribution 框架解决标签问题，支持多种具体算法

\section{Design}
% 设计
\label{sec:design}

The three requirements (a uniform record type, query-time aggregation, and deterministic labels for folding) drive the design.
% 三个需求（统一记录类型、查询时聚合和用于折叠的确定性标签）驱动了设计。
The profiling pipeline has five stages: (1)~parse raw traces into operations, (2)~label operations via intent recognition or mapping rules, (3)~filter by a user-specified predicate, (4)~project each operation onto a stack frame sequence chosen at query time, and (5)~fold operations with identical stacks, summing their weights.
% 分析管线有五个阶段：(1) 将原始 trace 解析为 operation，(2) 通过意图识别或映射规则标注 operation，(3) 按用户指定的谓词过滤，(4) 将每个 operation 投影到查询时选择的栈帧序列上，(5) 折叠具有相同栈的 operation 并求和权重。
We introduce two abstractions that satisfy R1 and R2, operations (\S\ref{sec:ops}) and operation stacks (\S\ref{sec:stacks}), and a pluggable intent-recognition mechanism (\S\ref{sec:intent}) that satisfies R3.
% 我们引入满足 R1 和 R2 的两个抽象——operation（\S\ref{sec:ops}）和 operation stack（\S\ref{sec:stacks}），以及满足 R3 的可插拔意图识别机制（\S\ref{sec:intent}）。

\subsection{Operations (R1: Uniform Record Type)}
% Operation（R1：统一记录类型）
\label{sec:ops}

Because agent activities span both the intent and system-effect layers described in \S\ref{sec:background}, a profiler should not distinguish between them at the object-model level.
% 由于智能体活动跨越 \S\ref{sec:background} 中描述的意图层和系统副作用层，分析器不应在对象模型层面区分它们。
\sys therefore represents every activity as a single abstraction, the \operation, a weighted record with string fields and additive measures.
% 因此 \sys 将每个活动表示为单一抽象——operation，一个带有字符串字段和可加度量的加权记录。

Each operation carries string fields (\texttt{project}, \texttt{agent}, \texttt{session}, \texttt{prompt\_tag}, \texttt{kind}, \texttt{model}, \texttt{path}, \texttt{domain}, \texttt{status}, \ldots) and additive measures (token count, duration, occurrence count).
% 每个 operation 携带字符串字段（\texttt{project}、\texttt{agent}、\texttt{session}、\texttt{prompt\_tag}、\texttt{kind}、\texttt{model}、\texttt{path}、\texttt{domain}、\texttt{status} 等）和可加度量（token 数、持续时间、出现次数）。
A prompt, an LLM call, a tool invocation, a file read, a GUI click, and a process event are all operation records that differ only in which fields are populated.
% 提示词、LLM 调用、工具调用、文件读取、GUI 点击和进程事件都是 operation 记录，仅在填充的字段上有所不同。

\subsection{Operation Stacks (R2: Query-Time Aggregation)}
% Operation Stack（R2：查询时聚合）
\label{sec:stacks}

An \opstack is an ordered list of fields chosen at query time.
% 一个 operation stack 是在查询时选择的字段有序列表。
Given a stack specification $[f_1, f_2, \ldots, f_k]$, each operation $o$ is projected to a frame sequence $\langle o.f_1, o.f_2, \ldots, o.f_k \rangle$.
% 给定栈规范 $[f_1, f_2, \ldots, f_k]$，每个 operation $o$ 被投影到帧序列 $\langle o.f_1, o.f_2, \ldots, o.f_k \rangle$。
Operations with identical frame sequences are merged and their weights are summed.
% 具有相同帧序列的 operation 被合并，权重求和。
The result is the standard folded-stack representation:
% 结果是标准的折叠栈表示：

\begin{small}
\begin{verbatim}
CPU:   main;parse;tokenize          42
Agent: prompt:debug;call:llm;tool:bash  4200
\end{verbatim}
\end{small}

\noindent Unlike CPU profiling, where the call stack is determined by execution, the stack is determined by the query.
% 与 CPU 分析中调用栈由执行决定不同，这里的栈由查询决定。
The same operations can be folded as a flat task summary, a fixed-session tree, a semantic phase/action hierarchy, or a dataset-native trajectory.
% 同一组 operation 可以折叠为扁平任务摘要、固定会话树、语义阶段/操作层次或数据集原生轨迹。
Changing the fields changes the aggregation without changing the data.
% 改变字段即改变聚合方式，而无需改变数据。
Failure, safety, and quality labels are ordinary fields that participate in the same projection, so the profiler handles diagnostic views without a separate mechanism.
% 故障、安全和质量标签是普通字段，参与相同的投影，因此分析器无需单独机制即可处理诊断视图。

Query-time stack selection directly addresses the fixed-hierarchy problem from \S\ref{sec:background}.
% 查询时栈选择直接解决了 \S\ref{sec:background} 中的固定层次问题。
Sessions and spans are optional operation fields, not structural skeleton nodes.
% 会话和 span 是可选的 operation 字段，而非结构性骨架节点。
Including \texttt{session} in the stack produces a per-session drilldown (equivalent to a trace tree).
% 在栈中包含 \texttt{session} 会产生按会话下钻（等同于 trace 树）。
Excluding it produces an aggregate view that existing trace tools do not natively support.
% 排除它则产生现有 trace 工具不原生支持的聚合视图。
The same data supports both debugging and profiling views.
% 同一数据同时支持调试和分析视图。

A \emph{view} is a triple $(\varphi, \sigma, w)$: a predicate $\varphi$ selects which operations participate, a stack function $\sigma = [f_1, \ldots, f_k]$ maps each operation to its frame sequence, and a weight function $w$ assigns a nonnegative measure.
% 一个视图是三元组 $(\varphi, \sigma, w)$：谓词 $\varphi$ 选择参与的 operation，栈函数 $\sigma = [f_1, \ldots, f_k]$ 将每个 operation 映射到其帧序列，权重函数 $w$ 赋予非负度量。
The view formalism supports arbitrary user-defined views.
% 视图形式化支持任意用户自定义视图。
Four built-in defaults (Table~\ref{tab:views}) answer common questions.
% 四个内置默认视图（Table~\ref{tab:views}）回答常见问题。

When a user does not supply a field chain, \sys can \emph{induce} operation stacks automatically by scoring adjacent operations for semantic shifts, field changes, and partition coherence, then cutting at boundaries where the evidence is strongest.
% 当用户不提供字段链时，\sys 可以通过对相邻 operation 评分语义转移、字段变化和分区一致性来自动诱导 operation stack，然后在证据最强的边界处切分。
The induced stacks have variable depth (the same field may recur at different recursive levels), and a configurable depth cap controls the granularity.
% 诱导的栈具有可变深度（同一字段可在不同递归层级重复出现），可配置的深度上限控制粒度。
This mode produces coarser groups than hand-specified stacks but requires no domain knowledge, making it useful for initial exploration (\S\ref{sec:eval}).
% 此模式产生比手动指定栈更粗的分组，但不需要领域知识，适用于初始探索（\S\ref{sec:eval}）。

你说得对。看了 §3.2 lines 365-370 和 eval lines 597-602：

**Stack induction**（自动栈构造）确实是一个 non-trivial 的算法。当用户不提供字段链时，系统通过 scoring semantic shifts、field changes、partition coherence 来自动发现聚合边界，产生 variable-depth stacks。Eval 里也单独测了（12 groups vs 285 fixed-session vs 1 flat，4/6 tasks 生成 variable-depth）。

所以完整的算法框架应该是两个：

```
Model: semantic operation stack model
  ├── semantic operations（数据模型：统一记录）
  └── operation stacks（聚合结构：字段投影→层次→fold）

Algorithms (填充模型的 slot):

  1. Intent Attribution（怎么获得确定性标签？）
     ├── regex rules
     ├── LLM tagger
     ├── unsupervised clustering
     ├── mapping rules
     └── boundary predictor

  2. Stack Construction（怎么构造聚合层次？）
     ├── manual field chain（用户指定，trivial）
     └── automatic stack induction（non-trivial）
           ├── semantic shift scoring
           ├── field-change detection
           ├── partition coherence
           └── variable-depth construction
```

content.text:
想清楚了——**Intent Attribution 先，Stack Construction 后。**

原因是依赖关系：

```
Pipeline 执行顺序：
  parse → label (intent attribution) → filter → project (stack construction) → fold
         ↑ 先                                    ↑ 后
```

Intent Attribution **产出**确定性标签，Stack Construction **消费**这些标签来构造帧序列然后 fold。没有确定性标签，stack 构造出来也无法 fold（两个相同意图的 prompt 产生不同帧，永远合不到一起）。

所以逻辑链是：
1. **Intent Attribution**（先解决最难的问题：从 NL 恢复确定性标识）
2. **Stack Construction**（有了标签之后，选字段构造层次，fold 同构栈）

当前 §3 的顺序（§3.2 stacks → §3.3 intent recognition）其实是反的——先讲了消费者再讲生产者。Intro 里应该纠正这个顺序。

content.text:
你说得对，我想错了。它们不是严格的生产者-消费者关系。

看回论文的实际数据流：

**不需要 Intent Attribution 也能构造 stack 的情况：**
- **原始字段**：`[project, session, kind, model]` — 这些字段本来就存在，直接投影就能 fold
- **结构化数据集**：mapping rules 从已有字段派生新字段（如 `phase:navigate=type:(click|scroll)`），完全不涉及 NL
- **自动 stack induction**：基于 field change 和 partition coherence 评分，可以只用原始字段

**需要 Intent Attribution 的情况：**
- 当你想按 `prompt_tag`（如 `review`, `debug`, `test`）聚合时，这个字段不存在于原始 trace 里，需要从 NL prompt 推导

所以它们是**并行、可组合的**，不是串行依赖：

```
Model: semantic operation stack model
  ├── semantic operations（数据模型）
  └── operation stacks（聚合结构）

Algorithms（并行，可组合）:
  ├── Intent Attribution（给 operation 增加语义字段）
  │     ├── regex rules
  │     ├── LLM tagger
  │     ├── clustering
  │     └── mapping rules
  └── Stack Construction（从可用字段构造聚合层次）
        ├── manual field chain
        └── automatic stack induction
```

两者都**丰富**模型，但互不依赖。Intent attribution 增加新字段，stack construction 决定用哪些字段构造层次。用了 attribution 之后 stack 更有语义价值，但不用也能 work。

这样的话 §3 现在的顺序（先 stacks 再 intent）反而是合理的——先讲通用机制（stack），再讲针对 NL 的增强（intent attribution）。Intro 里也应该这样呈现。

64	\section{Introduction}
65	\label{sec:intro}
66	
67	%% ¶1: Background + context
68	AI agents orchestrate multi-step activities that span two
69	layers: high-level intent (prompts, LLM calls, tool invocations) and
70	low-level system effects (process spawns, file and network I/O).
71	% AI 智能体编排跨越两层的多步骤活动：高层意图（提示词、LLM 调用、工具调用）和低层系统副作用（进程创建、文件和网络 I/O）。
72	As agents evolve from short, scripted workflows into complex systems
73	that run for hours, production teams accumulate hundreds of sessions
74	over weeks or months.
75	% 随着智能体从短小的脚本化工作流进化为运行数小时的复杂系统，生产团队在数周或数月内积累数百个会话。
76	
77	%% ¶2: Problem
78	To improve agent quality, safety, and cost efficiency, developers
79	need to analyze operational behavior across sessions to determine
80	which categories of tasks consume the most token budget, where
81	failures concentrate across workflows, and which behavioral patterns
82	trigger unsafe system side-effects.
83	% 为了提高智能体质量、安全性和成本效率，开发者需要跨会话分析运维行为：哪类任务消耗最多 token 预算、故障跨工作流集中在哪里、哪些行为模式触发不安全系统副作用。
84	Systems observability has long distinguished this kind of aggregate
85	analysis (profiling) from single-execution debugging.
86	% 系统可观测性早已将这种聚合分析（profiling）与单次执行调试区分开来。
87	Agent observability today has only the debugging layer.
88	% 当今的智能体可观测性只有调试层。
89	
90	%% ¶3: Existing solutions
91	Existing agent observability tools do not fill this gap.
92	% 现有智能体可观测性工具没有填补此缺口。
93	LangSmith~\cite{langsmith}, Langfuse~\cite{langfuse},
94	Phoenix~\cite{phoenix}, and OpenTelemetry GenAI~\cite{otel} organize
95	events into per-session span trees, effective for diagnosing a single
96	run but unable to aggregate across sessions by semantic category.
97	% LangSmith~\cite{langsmith}、Langfuse~\cite{langfuse}、Phoenix~\cite{phoenix} 和 OpenTelemetry GenAI~\cite{otel} 将事件组织为按会话的 span 树，有效诊断单次运行但无法按语义类别跨会话聚合。
98	Datadog LLM Observability~\cite{datadog-llmobs} clusters user
99	messages by topic, and Laminar~\cite{laminar-signals} extracts
100	structured signals from traces, but both characterize \emph{input
101	distributions} (``30\% of users ask code questions'') rather than
102	\emph{resource attribution} (``review tasks consume 40\% of the
103	token budget''), because labels at the request level do not propagate
104	to downstream tool calls and system effects.
105	% Datadog LLM Observability~\cite{datadog-llmobs} 按主题聚类用户消息，Laminar~\cite{laminar-signals} 从 trace 中提取结构化信号，但两者都刻画输入分布（"30\% 的用户提问代码问题"）而非资源归因（"review 任务消耗了 40\% 的 token 预算"），因为请求级的标签不会传播到下游工具调用和系统副作用。
106	
107	%% ¶4: Root cause — why traditional profiling doesn't transfer directly
108	The profiling methodology is well-established for traditional
109	software.
110	% Profiling 方法论对传统软件已经成熟。
111	Flame graphs~\cite{flamegraphs} fold identical call stacks into a
112	single chart where width represents cost.
113	% 火焰图~\cite{flamegraphs}将相同调用栈折叠为一张图，宽度代表开销。
114	Two properties make this work: function names are deterministic, so
115	identical code paths always produce the same stack frames, and runtime
116	call nesting provides the aggregation hierarchy.
117	% 两个特性使其有效：函数名是确定性的，相同代码路径始终产生相同栈帧；运行时调用嵌套提供聚合层次。
118	Agent traces break both (\S\ref{sec:background}).
119	% 智能体 trace 两者都打破了（\S\ref{sec:background}）。
120	First, the core unit of agent work is a natural-language prompt, and
121	two prompts expressing the same intent share no common string;
122	framework-level span names (\texttt{LLMCall}, \texttt{ToolInvoke})
123	describe mechanisms, not semantic intent.
124	% 第一，智能体工作的核心单元是自然语言提示词，表达相同意图的两个提示词没有共同字符串；框架级 span 名称（\texttt{LLMCall}、\texttt{ToolInvoke}）描述机制，而非语义意图。
125	Second, agent events have no runtime call-stack hierarchy: prompts,
126	tool calls, and system effects are not nested by execution the way
127	function calls produce stack frames.
128	% 第二，智能体事件没有运行时调用栈层次：提示词、工具调用和系统副作用不像函数调用那样通过执行嵌套产生栈帧。
129	
130	%% ¶5: Model
131	Despite these differences, the fundamental profiling
132	methodology (define units, assign stable labels, construct
133	aggregation hierarchies, fold identical stacks) transfers to agent
134	traces.
135	% 尽管有这些差异，基本的 profiling 方法论——定义单元、赋予稳定标签、构造聚合层次、折叠相同栈——可以迁移到智能体 trace。
136	We propose a \emph{semantic profiling model} with three components.
137	% 我们提出一个包含三个组件的语义 profiling 模型。
138	\emph{Semantic operations} are uniform records with string fields and
139	additive measures that represent all agent activities (prompts, LLM
140	calls, tool invocations, and system effects) without type-specific
141	objects.
142	% 语义 operation 是带有字符串字段和可加度量的统一记录，表示所有智能体活动——提示词、LLM 调用、工具调用和系统副作用——无需特定类型对象。
143	\emph{Intent attribution} derives deterministic, low-cardinality
144	labels from natural-language fields, restoring the folding
145	precondition that CPU profiling obtains for free from function names.
146	% 意图归因从自然语言字段派生确定性、低基数的标签，恢复 CPU profiling 从函数名免费获得的折叠前提条件。
147	\emph{Profile projections} select an ordered list of fields at query
148	time to construct aggregation hierarchies, replacing the runtime call
149	stack.
150	% Profile 投影在查询时选择字段有序列表来构造聚合层次，替代运行时调用栈。
151	Different field selections answer different questions (by task category, by execution phase, by session, or by
152	action type) from the same data.
153	% 不同的字段选择从同一数据回答不同问题——按任务类别、按执行阶段、按会话、按操作类型。
154	
155	%% ¶6: This paper + system + results
156	We implement this model in \sys, an offline profiler that compiles
157	local agent traces into pprof-compatible profiles
158	(Figure~\ref{fig:architecture}).
159	% 我们在 \sys 中实现此模型，这是一个离线 profiler，将本地智能体 trace 编译为 pprof 兼容的 profile（Figure~\ref{fig:architecture}）。
160	Intent attribution supports pluggable backends: regex rules for
161	production use, a local LLM tagger for exploration, and unsupervised
162	clustering for bootstrapping.
163	% 意图归因支持可插拔后端：正则规则用于生产、本地 LLM 标注器用于探索、无监督聚类用于引导。
164	On 325 real Codex and Claude sessions (183{,}714 system observations),
165	semantic profiling separates over 90\% of system-effect weight that
166	session-level views merge.
167	% 在 325 个真实 Codex 和 Claude 会话（183,714 个系统观测）上，语义 profiling 分离了会话级视图所混合的超过 90\% 的系统副作用权重。
168	On four public datasets with hidden ground-truth labels
169	(34{,}539 operations), profiler-ranked groups localize labeled
170	problems at 9.4\% inspection cost versus flat summaries, with 45\%
171	fewer groups than fixed-session drilldown.
172	% 在四个具有隐藏真实标签的公开数据集（34,539 个操作）上，profiler 排序的分组以 9.4\% 的检查成本定位标注问题，比固定会话下钻减少 45\% 的分组数。
173	Label quality exceeds V-measure 0.7 on 7 of 9 held-out datasets.
174	% 标签质量在 9 个保留数据集中的 7 个上超过 V-measure 0.7。
175	
176	%% ¶7: Contributions
177	This paper makes three contributions:
178	% 本文做出三项贡献：
179	
180	\begin{enumerate}
181	\item \textbf{Profiling gap and semantic profiling model.}
182	  We identify the missing profiling layer in agent observability and
183	  propose a model covering semantic operations, intent attribution,
184	  and profile projections
185	  (\S\ref{sec:background}--\S\ref{sec:design}).
186	% 识别智能体可观测性中缺失的 profiling 层，提出涵盖语义 operation、意图归因和 profile 投影的模型。
187	\item \textbf{System: \sys.}
188	  A profiler that implements this model with pluggable intent
189	  attribution and pprof-compatible output (\S\ref{sec:impl}).
190	% 系统：\sys。实现此模型的 profiler，具有可插拔意图归因和 pprof 兼容输出。
191	\item \textbf{Hidden-label evaluation.}
192	  We evaluate profiler output against hidden ground-truth trajectory
193	  labels, analogous to injecting known bottlenecks in CPU profiler
194	  evaluation, on 325 real sessions and 4 public datasets
195	  (\S\ref{sec:eval}).
196	% 隐藏标签评估。将 profiler 输出与隐藏的真实轨迹标签评分，类似于在 CPU profiler 评估中注入已知瓶颈，在 325 个真实会话和 4 个公开数据集上验证。
197	\end{enumerate}

% Datadog LLM Observability~\cite{datadog-llmobs} 按主题聚类用户消息，Laminar~\cite{laminar-signals} 从 trace 中提取结构化信号，但两者都刻画输入分布（"30\% 的用户提问代码问题"）而非资源归因（"review 任务消耗了 40\% 的 token 预算"），因为请求级的标签不会传播到下游工具调用和系统副作用。

%% ¶4: Root cause — why traditional profiling doesn't transfer directly
The profiling methodology is well-established for traditional
software.
% Profiling 方法论对传统软件已经成熟。
Flame graphs~\cite{flamegraphs} fold identical call stacks into a
single chart where width represents cost.
% 火焰图~\cite{flamegraphs}将相同调用栈折叠为一张图，宽度代表开销。
Two properties make this work: function names are deterministic, so
identical code paths always produce the same stack frames, and runtime
call nesting provides the aggregation hierarchy.
% 两个特性使其有效：函数名是确定性的，相同代码路径始终产生相同栈帧；运行时调用嵌套提供聚合层次。
Agent traces break both (\S\ref{sec:background}).
% 智能体 trace 两者都打破了（\S\ref{sec:background}）。
First, the core unit of agent work is a natural-language prompt, and
two prompts expressing the same intent share no common string;
framework-level span names (\texttt{LLMCall}, \texttt{ToolInvoke})
describe mechanisms, not semantic intent.
% 第一，智能体工作的核心单元是自然语言提示词，表达相同意图的两个提示词没有共同字符串；框架级 span 名称（\texttt{LLMCall}、\texttt{ToolInvoke}）描述机制，而非语义意图。
Second, agent events have no runtime call-stack hierarchy: prompts,
tool calls, and system effects are not nested by execution the way
function calls produce stack frames.
% 第二，智能体事件没有运行时调用栈层次：提示词、工具调用和系统副作用不像函数调用那样通过执行嵌套产生栈帧。

%% ¶5: Model
Despite these differences, the fundamental profiling
methodology (define units, assign stable labels, construct
aggregation hierarchies, fold identical stacks) transfers to agent
traces.
% 尽管有这些差异，基本的 profiling 方法论——定义单元、赋予稳定标签、构造聚合层次、折叠相同栈——可以迁移到智能体 trace。
We propose a \emph{semantic profiling model} with three components.
% 我们提出一个包含三个组件的语义 profiling 模型。
\emph{Semantic operations} are uniform records with string fields and
additive measures that represent all agent activities (prompts, LLM
calls, tool invocations, and system effects) without type-specific
objects.
% 语义 operation 是带有字符串字段和可加度量的统一记录，表示所有智能体活动——提示词、LLM 调用、工具调用和系统副作用——无需特定类型对象。
\emph{Intent attribution} derives deterministic, low-cardinality
labels from natural-language fields, restoring the folding
precondition that CPU profiling obtains for free from function names.
% 意图归因从自然语言字段派生确定性、低基数的标签，恢复 CPU profiling 从函数名免费获得的折叠前提条件。
\emph{Profile projections} select an ordered list of fields at query
time to construct aggregation hierarchies, replacing the runtime call
stack.
% Profile 投影在查询时选择字段有序列表来构造聚合层次，替代运行时调用栈。
Different field selections answer different questions (by task category, by execution phase, by session, or by
action type) from the same data.
% 不同的字段选择从同一数据回答不同问题——按任务类别、按执行阶段、按会话、按操作类型。

%% ¶6: This paper + system + results
We implement this model in \sys, an offline profiler that compiles
local agent traces into pprof-compatible profiles
(Figure~\ref{fig:architecture}).
% 我们在 \sys 中实现此模型，这是一个离线 profiler，将本地智能体 trace 编译为 pprof 兼容的 profile（Figure~\ref{fig:architecture}）。
Intent attribution supports pluggable backends: regex rules for
production use, a local LLM tagger for exploration, and unsupervised
clustering for bootstrapping.
% 意图归因支持可插拔后端：正则规则用于生产、本地 LLM 标注器用于探索、无监督聚类用于引导。
On 325 real Codex and Claude sessions (183{,}714 system observations),
semantic profiling separates over 90\% of system-effect weight that
session-level views merge.
% 在 325 个真实 Codex 和 Claude 会话（183,714 个系统观测）上，语义 profiling 分离了会话级视图所混合的超过 90\% 的系统副作用权重。
On four public datasets with hidden ground-truth labels
(34{,}539 operations), profiler-ranked groups localize labeled
problems at 9.4\% inspection cost versus flat summaries, with 45\%
fewer groups than fixed-session drilldown.
% 在四个具有隐藏真实标签的公开数据集（34,539 个操作）上，profiler 排序的分组以 9.4\% 的检查成本定位标注问题，比固定会话下钻减少 45\% 的分组数。
Label quality exceeds V-measure 0.7 on 7 of 9 held-out datasets.
% 标签质量在 9 个保留数据集中的 7 个上超过 V-measure 0.7。

%% ¶7: Contributions
This paper makes three contributions:
% 本文做出三项贡献：

\begin{enumerate}
\item \textbf{Profiling gap and semantic profiling model.}
  We identify the missing profiling layer in agent observability and
  propose a model covering semantic operations, intent attribution,
  and profile projections
  (\S\ref{sec:background}--\S\ref{sec:design}).
% 识别智能体可观测性中缺失的 profiling 层，提出涵盖语义 operation、意图归因和 profile 投影的模型。
\item \textbf{System: \sys.}
  A profiler that implements this model with pluggable intent
  attribution and pprof-compatible output (\S\ref{sec:impl}).
% 系统：\sys。实现此模型的 profiler，具有可插拔意图归因和 pprof 兼容输出。
\item \textbf{Hidden-label evaluation.}
  We evaluate profiler output against hidden ground-truth trajectory
  labels, analogous to injecting known bottlenecks in CPU profiler
  evaluation, on 325 real sessions and 4 public datasets
  (\S\ref{sec:eval}).
% 隐藏标签评估。将 profiler 输出与隐藏的真实轨迹标签评分，类似于在 CPU profiler 评估中注入已知瓶颈，在 325 个真实会话和 4 个公开数据集上验证。
\end{enumerate}

%% ¶5: Model
Despite these differences, the fundamental profiling
methodology (define units, assign stable labels, construct
aggregation hierarchies, fold identical stacks) transfers to agent
traces.
% 尽管有这些差异，基本的 profiling 方法论——定义单元、赋予稳定标签、构造聚合层次、折叠相同栈——可以迁移到智能体 trace。
We propose a \emph{semantic profiling model} with three components.
% 我们提出一个包含三个组件的语义 profiling 模型。
\emph{Semantic operations} are uniform records with string fields and
additive measures that represent all agent activities (prompts, LLM
calls, tool invocations, and system effects) without type-specific
objects.
% 语义 operation 是带有字符串字段和可加度量的统一记录，表示所有智能体活动——提示词、LLM 调用、工具调用和系统副作用——无需特定类型对象。
\emph{Intent attribution} derives deterministic, low-cardinality
labels from natural-language fields, restoring the folding
precondition that CPU profiling obtains for free from function names.
% 意图归因从自然语言字段派生确定性、低基数的标签，恢复 CPU profiling 从函数名免费获得的折叠前提条件。
\emph{Profile projections} select an ordered list of fields at query
time to construct aggregation hierarchies, replacing the runtime call
stack.
% Profile 投影在查询时选择字段有序列表来构造聚合层次，替代运行时调用栈。
Different field selections answer different questions (by task category, by execution phase, by session, or by
action type) from the same data.
% 不同的字段选择从同一数据回答不同问题——按任务类别、按执行阶段、按会话、按操作类型。

%% ¶6: This paper + system + results
We implement this model in \sys, an offline profiler that compiles
local agent traces into pprof-compatible profiles
(Figure~\ref{fig:architecture}).
% 我们在 \sys 中实现此模型，这是一个离线 profiler，将本地智能体 trace 编译为 pprof 兼容的 profile（Figure~\ref{fig:architecture}）。

production use, a local LLM tagger for exploration, and unsupervised
clustering for bootstrapping.

semantic profiling separates over 90\% of system-effect weight that
session-level views merge.

problems at 9.4\% inspection cost versus flat summaries, with 45\%
fewer groups than fixed-session drilldown.

  propose a model covering semantic operations, intent attribution,
  and profile projections

% 识别智能体可观测性中缺失的 profiling 层，提出涵盖语义 operation、意图归因和 profile 投影的模型。
\item \textbf{System: \sys.}

  attribution and pprof-compatible output (\S\ref{sec:impl}).
% 系统：\sys。实现此模型的 profiler，具有可插拔意图归因和 pprof 兼容输出。
\item \textbf{Hidden-label evaluation.}

  labels, analogous to injecting known bottlenecks in CPU profiler
  evaluation, on 325 real sessions and 4 public datasets
  (\S\ref{sec:eval}).
% 隐藏标签评估。将 profiler 输出与隐藏的真实轨迹标签评分，类似于在 CPU profiler 评估中注入已知瓶颈，在 325 个真实会话和 4 个公开数据集上验证。
\end{enumerate}

32	aggregate analysis of which task categories consume the most budget,
33	where failures concentrate, and which workflows trigger unsafe
34	side-effects, but today the only option is manual inspection of
35	individual sessions.

38	traditional software does not directly apply because agent traces lack
39	deterministic identifiers and runtime call-stack hierarchies.

68	%% ¶1: Background + context
69	AI agents orchestrate multi-step activities that span two
70	layers: high-level intent (prompts, LLM calls, tool invocations) and
71	low-level system effects (process spawns, file and network I/O).
72	% AI 智能体编排跨越两层的多步骤活动：高层意图（提示词、LLM 调用、工具调用）和低层系统副作用（进程创建、文件和网络 I/O）。
73	As agents evolve from short, scripted workflows into complex systems
74	that run for hours, production teams accumulate hundreds of sessions
75	over weeks or months.
76	% 随着智能体从短小的脚本化工作流进化为运行数小时的复杂系统，生产团队在数周或数月内积累数百个会话。
77	
78	%% ¶2: Problem
79	To improve agent quality, safety, and cost efficiency, developers
80	need to analyze operational behavior across sessions to determine
81	which categories of tasks consume the most token budget, where
82	failures concentrate across workflows, and which behavioral patterns
83	trigger unsafe system side-effects.
84	% 为了提高智能体质量、安全性和成本效率，开发者需要跨会话分析运维行为：哪类任务消耗最多 token 预算、故障跨工作流集中在哪里、哪些行为模式触发不安全系统副作用。
85	Systems observability has long distinguished this kind of aggregate
86	analysis (profiling) from single-execution debugging.
87	% 系统可观测性早已将这种聚合分析（profiling）与单次执行调试区分开来。
88	Agent observability today has only the debugging layer.
89	% 当今的智能体可观测性只有调试层。
90	
91	%% ¶3: Existing solutions
92	Existing agent observability tools do not fill this gap.
93	% 现有智能体可观测性工具没有填补此缺口。
94	LangSmith~\cite{langsmith}, Langfuse~\cite{langfuse},
95	Phoenix~\cite{phoenix}, and OpenTelemetry GenAI~\cite{otel} organize
96	events into per-session span trees, effective for diagnosing a single
97	run but unable to aggregate across sessions by semantic category.
98	% LangSmith~\cite{langsmith}、Langfuse~\cite{langfuse}、Phoenix~\cite{phoenix} 和 OpenTelemetry GenAI~\cite{otel} 将事件组织为按会话的 span 树，有效诊断单次运行但无法按语义类别跨会话聚合。
99	Datadog LLM Observability~\cite{datadog-llmobs} clusters user
100	messages by topic, and Laminar~\cite{laminar-signals} extracts
101	structured signals from traces, but both characterize \emph{input
102	distributions} (``30\% of users ask code questions'') rather than
103	\emph{resource attribution} (``review tasks consume 40\% of the
104	token budget''), because labels at the request level do not propagate
105	to downstream tool calls and system effects.
106	% Datadog LLM Observability~\cite{datadog-llmobs} 按主题聚类用户消息，Laminar~\cite{laminar-signals} 从 trace 中提取结构化信号，但两者都刻画输入分布（"30\% 的用户提问代码问题"）而非资源归因（"review 任务消耗了 40\% 的 token 预算"），因为请求级的标签不会传播到下游工具调用和系统副作用。
107	
108	%% ¶4: Root cause — why traditional profiling doesn't transfer directly
109	The profiling methodology is well-established for traditional
110	software.
111	% Profiling 方法论对传统软件已经成熟。
112	Flame graphs~\cite{flamegraphs} fold identical call stacks into a
113	single chart where width represents cost.
114	% 火焰图~\cite{flamegraphs}将相同调用栈折叠为一张图，宽度代表开销。
115	Two properties make this work: function names are deterministic, so
116	identical code paths always produce the same stack frames, and runtime
117	call nesting provides the aggregation hierarchy.
118	% 两个特性使其有效：函数名是确定性的，相同代码路径始终产生相同栈帧；运行时调用嵌套提供聚合层次。
119	Agent traces break both (\S\ref{sec:background}).
120	% 智能体 trace 两者都打破了（\S\ref{sec:background}）。
121	First, the core unit of agent work is a natural-language prompt, and
122	two prompts expressing the same intent share no common string;
123	framework-level span names (\texttt{LLMCall}, \texttt{ToolInvoke})
124	describe mechanisms, not semantic intent.
125	% 第一，智能体工作的核心单元是自然语言提示词，表达相同意图的两个提示词没有共同字符串；框架级 span 名称（\texttt{LLMCall}、\texttt{ToolInvoke}）描述机制，而非语义意图。
126	Second, agent events have no runtime call-stack hierarchy: prompts,
127	tool calls, and system effects are not nested by execution the way
128	function calls produce stack frames.
129	% 第二，智能体事件没有运行时调用栈层次：提示词、工具调用和系统副作用不像函数调用那样通过执行嵌套产生栈帧。
130	
131	%% ¶5: Model
132	Despite these differences, the fundamental profiling
133	methodology (define units, assign stable labels, construct
134	aggregation hierarchies, fold identical stacks) transfers to agent
135	traces.
136	% 尽管有这些差异，基本的 profiling 方法论——定义单元、赋予稳定标签、构造聚合层次、折叠相同栈——可以迁移到智能体 trace。
137	We propose a \emph{semantic operation stack model} with two
138	components.
139	% 我们提出一个包含两个组件的语义 operation stack 模型。
140	\emph{Operations} are uniform records with string fields and
141	additive measures that represent all agent activities (prompts, LLM
142	calls, tool invocations, and system effects) without type-specific
143	objects.
144	% Operation 是带有字符串字段和可加度量的统一记录，表示所有智能体活动（提示词、LLM 调用、工具调用和系统副作用），无需特定类型对象。
145	\emph{Operation stacks} are ordered lists of fields chosen at query
146	time; each operation is projected to a frame sequence, and operations
147	with identical sequences merge, producing the folded-stack
148	representation that flame graphs visualize.
149	% Operation stack 是在查询时选择的字段有序列表；每个 operation 被投影到帧序列，具有相同序列的 operation 合并，产生火焰图可视化的折叠栈表示。
150	Different field selections answer different questions (by task
151	category, by execution phase, by session, or by action type) from
152	the same data.
153	% 不同的字段选择从同一数据回答不同问题（按任务类别、按执行阶段、按会话或按操作类型）。
154	
155	%% ¶6: This paper + system + results

... [768 lines truncated] ...

The three requirements (a uniform record type, query-time aggregation, and deterministic labels for folding) drive the design.
% 三个需求（统一记录类型、查询时聚合和用于折叠的确定性标签）驱动了设计。
The profiling pipeline has five stages: (1)~parse raw traces into operations, (2)~label operations via intent recognition or mapping rules, (3)~filter by a user-specified predicate, (4)~project each operation onto a stack frame sequence chosen at query time, and (5)~fold operations with identical stacks, summing their weights.
% 分析管线有五个阶段：(1) 将原始 trace 解析为 operation，(2) 通过意图识别或映射规则标注 operation，(3) 按用户指定的谓词过滤，(4) 将每个 operation 投影到查询时选择的栈帧序列上，(5) 折叠具有相同栈的 operation 并求和权重。
We introduce two abstractions that satisfy R1 and R2, operations (\S\ref{sec:ops}) and operation stacks (\S\ref{sec:stacks}), and a pluggable intent-recognition mechanism (\S\ref{sec:intent}) that satisfies R3.
% 我们引入满足 R1 和 R2 的两个抽象——operation（\S\ref{sec:ops}）和 operation stack（\S\ref{sec:stacks}），以及满足 R3 的可插拔意图识别机制（\S\ref{sec:intent}）。

\subsection{Operations (R1: Uniform Record Type)}
% Operation（R1：统一记录类型）
\label{sec:ops}

Because agent activities span both the intent and system-effect layers described in \S\ref{sec:background}, a profiler should not distinguish between them at the object-model level.
% 由于智能体活动跨越 \S\ref{sec:background} 中描述的意图层和系统副作用层，分析器不应在对象模型层面区分它们。
\sys therefore represents every activity as a single abstraction, the \operation, a weighted record with string fields and additive measures.
% 因此 \sys 将每个活动表示为单一抽象——operation，一个带有字符串字段和可加度量的加权记录。

Each operation carries string fields (\texttt{project}, \texttt{agent}, \texttt{session}, \texttt{prompt\_tag}, \texttt{kind}, \texttt{model}, \texttt{path}, \texttt{domain}, \texttt{status}, \ldots) and additive measures (token count, duration, occurrence count).
% 每个 operation 携带字符串字段（\texttt{project}、\texttt{agent}、\texttt{session}、\texttt{prompt\_tag}、\texttt{kind}、\texttt{model}、\texttt{path}、\texttt{domain}、\texttt{status} 等）和可加度量（token 数、持续时间、出现次数）。
A prompt, an LLM call, a tool invocation, a file read, a GUI click, and a process event are all operation records that differ only in which fields are populated.
% 提示词、LLM 调用、工具调用、文件读取、GUI 点击和进程事件都是 operation 记录，仅在填充的字段上有所不同。
