74	%% ===================================================================
75	\section{Introduction}
76	\label{sec:intro}
77	
78	%% ¶1: Background + context
79	AI agents orchestrate multi-step activities that span two
80	layers, high-level intent (prompts, LLM calls, tool invocations) and
81	low-level system effects (process spawns, file and network I/O).
82	% AI 智能体编排跨越两层的多步骤活动：高层意图（提示词、LLM 调用、工具调用）和低层系统副作用（进程创建、文件和网络 I/O）。
83	As agents evolve from short, scripted workflows into complex systems
84	that run for hours, production teams accumulate hundreds of sessions
85	over weeks or months.
86	% 随着智能体从短小的脚本化工作流进化为运行数小时的复杂系统，生产团队在数周或数月内积累数百个会话。
87	
88	%% ¶2: Problem
89	To improve agent quality, safety, and cost efficiency, developers
90	need to analyze operational behavior across sessions.
91	Which categories of tasks consume the most token budget? Where do
92	failures concentrate across workflows? Which behavioral patterns
93	trigger unsafe system effects?
94	% 为了提高智能体质量、安全性和成本效率，开发者需要跨会话分析运维行为：哪类任务消耗最多 token 预算、故障跨工作流集中在哪里、哪些行为模式触发不安全系统副作用。
95	Systems observability has long distinguished this kind of aggregate
96	analysis (profiling) from single-execution debugging.
97	% 系统可观测性早已将这种聚合分析（profiling）与单次执行调试区分开来。
98	Agent observability today has only the debugging layer.
99	% 当今的智能体可观测性只有调试层。
100	
101	%% ¶3: Existing solutions
102	Existing agent observability tools do not fill this gap.
103	% 现有智能体可观测性工具没有填补此缺口。
104	LangSmith~\cite{langsmith}, Langfuse~\cite{langfuse},
105	Phoenix~\cite{phoenix}, and OpenTelemetry GenAI~\cite{otel} organize
106	events into per-session span trees, effective for diagnosing a single
107	run but unable to aggregate across sessions by semantic category.
108	% LangSmith~\cite{langsmith}、Langfuse~\cite{langfuse}、Phoenix~\cite{phoenix} 和 OpenTelemetry GenAI~\cite{otel} 将事件组织为按会话的 span 树，有效诊断单次运行但无法按语义类别跨会话聚合。
109	Datadog LLM Observability~\cite{datadog-llmobs} clusters user
110	messages by topic, and Laminar~\cite{laminar-signals} extracts
111	structured signals from traces, but both characterize \emph{input
112	distributions} (``30\% of users ask code questions'') rather than
113	\emph{resource attribution} (``review tasks consume 40\% of the
114	token budget''), because labels at the request level do not propagate
115	to downstream tool calls and system effects.
116	% Datadog LLM Observability~\cite{datadog-llmobs} 按主题聚类用户消息，Laminar~\cite{laminar-signals} 从 trace 中提取结构化信号，但两者都刻画输入分布（"30\% 的用户提问代码问题"）而非资源归因（"review 任务消耗了 40\% 的 token 预算"），因为请求级的标签不会传播到下游工具调用和系统副作用。
117	
118	%% ¶4: Challenge — why traditional profiling doesn't transfer directly
119	The profiling methodology is well-established for traditional
120	software.
121	% Profiling 方法论对传统软件已经成熟。
122	Flame graphs~\cite{flamegraphs} fold identical call stacks into a
123	single chart where width represents cost.
124	% 火焰图~\cite{flamegraphs}将相同调用栈折叠为一张图，宽度代表开销。
125	Two properties make this work.
126	Function names are deterministic, so identical code paths always
127	produce the same stack frames, and runtime call nesting provides the
128	aggregation hierarchy.
129	% 两个特性使其有效：函数名是确定性的，相同代码路径始终产生相同栈帧；运行时调用嵌套提供聚合层次。
130	Agent traces break both (\S\ref{sec:background}).
131	% 智能体 trace 两者都打破了（\S\ref{sec:background}）。
132	First, the core unit of agent work is a natural-language prompt, and
133	two prompts expressing the same intent share no common string.
134	Framework-level span names (\texttt{LLMCall}, \texttt{ToolInvoke})
135	describe mechanisms, not semantic intent.
136	% 第一，智能体工作的核心单元是自然语言提示词，表达相同意图的两个提示词没有共同字符串；框架级 span 名称（\texttt{LLMCall}、\texttt{ToolInvoke}）描述机制，而非语义意图。
137	Second, agent events have no runtime call-stack hierarchy because
138	prompts, tool calls, and system effects are not nested by execution
139	the way function calls produce stack frames.
140	% 第二，智能体事件没有运行时调用栈层次：提示词、工具调用和系统副作用不像函数调用那样通过执行嵌套产生栈帧。
141	
142	%% ¶5: Model
143	Despite these differences, the fundamental profiling
144	methodology (define units, assign stable labels, construct
145	aggregation hierarchies, fold identical stacks) transfers to agent
146	traces.
147	% 尽管有这些差异，基本的 profiling 方法论——定义单元、赋予稳定标签、构造聚合层次、折叠相同栈——可以迁移到智能体 trace。
148	We propose a \emph{semantic operation stack model} with two
149	components.
150	% 我们提出一个包含两个组件的语义 operation stack 模型。
151	\emph{Operations} are uniform records with string fields and
152	additive measures that represent all agent activities (prompts, LLM
153	calls, tool invocations, and system effects) without type-specific
154	objects.
155	% Operation 是带有字符串字段和可加度量的统一记录，表示所有智能体活动（提示词、LLM 调用、工具调用和系统副作用），无需特定类型对象。

content.text:
Intro ¶4 当前写法：

```
The profiling methodology is well-established for traditional software.
Flame graphs fold identical call stacks into a single chart where width represents cost.
```

这里 "Flame graphs" 直接作为主语出现，像是在说 flame graph = THE methodology。更准确的写法应该和 abstract 一致，用 "such as"：

> The profiling methodology is well-established for traditional software. Tools such as flame graphs fold identical call stacks into a single chart where width represents cost.

要改吗？

message.content: flamegraph 不是 profiling 方法吧? 你想想 profiling 方法核心是什么

content.text:
你说得对。Flame graph 是**可视化**，不是 profiling 方法本身。

Profiling 方法论的核心是：
1. 定义度量单元（sample）
2. 用确定性标识符标记（function name）
3. 构造聚合层次（call stack）
4. Fold 相同 pattern，sum weights

Flame graph 只是把 fold 之后的结果**画出来**（宽度 = 开销）。它是 visualization tool，不是 methodology。

所以：
- Abstract S5 不应该说 "profiling methodology such as flame graphs"
- 应该说 "the profiling methodology that traditional software uses" 就够了，不需要提 flame graph
- Intro ¶4 也应该区分："Profilers fold identical call stacks... Flame graphs visualize the result."

Abstract S5 改为：

> The profiling methodology that traditional software uses to answer these questions does not directly apply because agent traces lack deterministic identifiers and runtime call-stack hierarchies.

Intro ¶4 改为类似：

> The profiling methodology is well-established for traditional software. Profilers aggregate execution by folding identical call stacks, and flame graphs~\cite{flamegraphs} visualize the result as charts where width represents cost.

要改吗？

message.content: 你确定? 你再想想传统方法的核心是什么? 怎么 make 一个很核心的 claim?

content.text:
让我重新想。

传统 profiling 的核心不是 4 个步骤，是一个操作：**fold identical stacks, sum weights.** 这是 profiling 和 logging/tracing 的本质区别。Log 是一条条记录，trace 是一棵棵树，profile 是 fold 之后的聚合。

这个操作能 work 的前提是：
- 相同的执行路径产生相同的栈 → 所以能 merge
- 函数名是确定性的，call stack 是运行时给的 → 这两个属性让 "相同" 有定义

所以核心 claim 应该是：

> **Profiling is fundamentally about folding identical stacks.** Traditional software gets mergeable stacks for free from deterministic function names and runtime call hierarchies. Agent traces have neither, but the folding principle still applies once operations provide uniform units and operation stacks provide query-time hierarchies.

这比 "profiling methodology transfers" 更精确——它指出了 profiling 的**原子操作**是什么（fold），以及为什么 agent 场景需要重新构造这个操作的输入（units + hierarchies），而不是重新发明 profiling 本身。

这样 abstract S5 可以改成：

> Profiling is fundamentally about folding identical stacks, but agent traces lack the deterministic identifiers and runtime call hierarchies that make stacks mergeable.

这样好吗？

message.content: 不对. 你再按照 osdi 等等的形态想想, 传统 system commutity 怎么定义 profiling 的?

content.text:
你说得对，我搞反了。

传统 systems community 对 profiling 的定义核心是 **resource attribution** — 把资源消耗归因到负责的代码路径/组件。"Where does the CPU time go?" "Which functions allocate the most memory?"

Profiling = **attribution**，不是 fold。Fold 是实现 attribution 的聚合机制。Flame graph 是 attribution 结果的可视化。

层次是：
```
目的：Resource Attribution（把资源消耗归因到负责实体）
机制：Sample → Attribute → Aggregate (fold identical stacks)
可视化：Flame graph
```

对传统软件：
- 资源 = CPU time, memory, I/O
- 实体 = function, call stack
- Attribution 是 trivial 的，因为函数名确定性 + call stack 运行时给

对 agent：
- 资源 = tokens, time, file ops, network
- 实体 = task category, workflow phase, semantic intent  
- Attribution 是 **hard** 的，因为实体（语义类别）不存在于原始 trace 中，必须构造

所以 abstract S5 应该是：

> Profiling attributes resource consumption to responsible code paths, but agent traces lack the deterministic identifiers and structural hierarchies that make this attribution possible.

Intro ¶4 也应该先说 attribution 是核心，然后 flame graph 是可视化：

> Profiling attributes resource consumption to responsible code paths. In traditional software, deterministic function names and runtime call stacks make attribution straightforward, and flame graphs visualize the result.

这也和 intro ¶3 已有的 "resource attribution" 术语一致。要改吗？

定义 profiling 为 "attributes resource consumption to responsible code
  paths by aggregation" 我们这样定义准确吗?

content.text:
不准确。如果定义 profiling 为 "attributes to code paths"，那我们自己的系统就不符合这个定义——我们归因到的是 semantic categories，不是 code paths。自相矛盾。

Profiling 的通用定义应该是：

> **Profiling attributes resource consumption to responsible entities by aggregation.**

"Code paths" 是传统软件里这些 entities 的具体形式。"Semantic categories" 是 agent 场景下的具体形式。

所以 S3 应该用通用定义，code paths vs semantic categories 的区别留给 S5：

```
S3: To answer similar questions in traditional systems software, 
    profiling attributes resource consumption to responsible 
    entities by aggregation, rather than single-execution 
    debugging or tracing.

S5: In traditional software, those entities are code paths 
    with deterministic function names. Agent behavior differs: 
    the responsible entities are semantic categories such as 
    task intent and workflow phase, and agent traces lack the 
    deterministic identifiers and structural hierarchies that 
    make aggregation possible.
```

这样：
1. Profiling 定义是通用的（不限于 code paths）
2. 我们的系统**符合**这个定义（attribute to semantic categories）
3. 传统 vs agent 的区别是 entities 不同，不是方法论不同

%% ¶2: Problem
To improve agent quality, safety, and cost efficiency, developers
need to analyze operational behavior across sessions.
Which categories of tasks consume the most token budget? Where do
failures concentrate across workflows? Which behavioral patterns
trigger unsafe system effects?
% 为了提高智能体质量、安全性和成本效率，开发者需要跨会话分析运维行为：哪类任务消耗最多 token 预算、故障跨工作流集中在哪里、哪些行为模式触发不安全系统副作用。
Systems observability has long distinguished this kind of aggregate
analysis (profiling) from single-execution debugging.
% 系统可观测性早已将这种聚合分析（profiling）与单次执行调试区分开来。
Agent observability today has only the debugging layer.
% 当今的智能体可观测性只有调试层。

%% ¶3: Existing solutions
Existing agent observability tools do not fill this gap.
% 现有智能体可观测性工具没有填补此缺口。
LangSmith~\cite{langsmith}, Langfuse~\cite{langfuse},
Phoenix~\cite{phoenix}, and OpenTelemetry GenAI~\cite{otel} organize
events into per-session span trees, effective for diagnosing a single
run but unable to aggregate across sessions by semantic category.
% LangSmith~\cite{langsmith}、Langfuse~\cite{langfuse}、Phoenix~\cite{phoenix} 和 OpenTelemetry GenAI~\cite{otel} 将事件组织为按会话的 span 树，有效诊断单次运行但无法按语义类别跨会话聚合。
Datadog LLM Observability~\cite{datadog-llmobs} clusters user
messages by topic, and Laminar~\cite{laminar-signals} extracts
structured signals from traces, but both characterize \emph{input
distributions} (``30\% of users ask code questions'') rather than
\emph{resource attribution} (``review tasks consume 40\% of the
token budget''), because labels at the request level do not propagate
to downstream tool calls and system effects.
% Datadog LLM Observability~\cite{datadog-llmobs} 按主题聚类用户消息，Laminar~\cite{laminar-signals} 从 trace 中提取结构化信号，但两者都刻画输入分布（"30\% 的用户提问代码问题"）而非资源归因（"review 任务消耗了 40\% 的 token 预算"），因为请求级的标签不会传播到下游工具调用和系统副作用。

%% ¶4: Challenge — why traditional profiling doesn't transfer directly
The profiling methodology is well-established for traditional
software.
% Profiling 方法论对传统软件已经成熟。
Flame graphs~\cite{flamegraphs} fold identical call stacks into a
single chart where width represents cost.
% 火焰图~\cite{flamegraphs}将相同调用栈折叠为一张图，宽度代表开销。
Two properties make this work.
Function names are deterministic, so identical code paths always
produce the same stack frames, and runtime call nesting provides the
aggregation hierarchy.
% 两个特性使其有效：函数名是确定性的，相同代码路径始终产生相同栈帧；运行时调用嵌套提供聚合层次。
Agent traces break both (\S\ref{sec:background}).
% 智能体 trace 两者都打破了（\S\ref{sec:background}）。
First, the core unit of agent work is a natural-language prompt, and
two prompts expressing the same intent share no common string.
Framework-level span names (\texttt{LLMCall}, \texttt{ToolInvoke})
describe mechanisms, not semantic intent.
% 第一，智能体工作的核心单元是自然语言提示词，表达相同意图的两个提示词没有共同字符串；框架级 span 名称（\texttt{LLMCall}、\texttt{ToolInvoke}）描述机制，而非语义意图。
Second, agent events have no runtime call-stack hierarchy because
prompts, tool calls, and system effects are not nested by execution
the way function calls produce stack frames.
% 第二，智能体事件没有运行时调用栈层次：提示词、工具调用和系统副作用不像函数调用那样通过执行嵌套产生栈帧。

\begin{abstract}
%% S1: Context (→¶1)
AI agents orchestrate multi-step activities across hundreds of
sessions.
% AI 智能体跨数百个会话编排多步骤活动。
%% S2: Need (→¶2)
To improve quality, safety, and cost efficiency, developers need to
determine which task categories consume the most budget, where
failures concentrate, and which workflows trigger unsafe effects.
% 为了提高质量、安全性和成本效率，开发者需要确定哪类任务消耗最多预算、故障集中在哪里、哪些工作流触发不安全副作用。
%% S3: Traditional profiling (→¶2+¶4)
To answer similar questions in traditional systems software, profiling
attributes resource consumption to responsible entities, such as code
paths, by aggregation, rather than single-execution debugging or
tracing.
% 在传统系统软件中，profiling 通过聚合将资源消耗归因到负责实体（如代码路径），而非单次执行调试或 tracing。
%% S4: Gap (→¶2+¶3)
Yet existing agent tools support debugging and tracing but not
profiling.
% 然而现有智能体工具支持调试和 tracing，但不支持 profiling。
%% S5: Agent challenge (→¶4)
Agent behavior differs fundamentally from code execution.
The responsible entities are semantic categories such as task intent
and workflow phase, not code paths, and agent traces lack the
deterministic identifiers and structural hierarchies that make
aggregation possible.
% 智能体行为与代码执行有根本不同。负责实体是语义类别（如任务意图和工作流阶段），而非代码路径，且智能体 trace 缺乏使聚合成为可能的确定性标识符和结构层次。
%% S6: Model (→¶5)
We propose a \emph{semantic operation stack model}.
Uniform \emph{operations} represent all agent activities, and
\emph{operation stacks} replace the runtime call stack with
query-time field projections that fold identical frame sequences.
% 我们提出语义 operation stack 模型。统一的 operation 表示所有智能体活动，operation stack 用查询时字段投影替代运行时调用栈，折叠相同帧序列。
%% S7: System (→¶6)
\sys implements this model as a profiler with pluggable algorithms
for \emph{intent attribution} and \emph{stack construction},
compiling local agent traces into pprof-compatible profiles.
% \sys 将此模型实现为具有可插拔意图归因和栈构造算法的 profiler，将本地智能体 trace 编译为 pprof 兼容的 profile。
%% S8-S9: Results (→¶6)
On 325 real agent sessions, semantic profiling separates over 90\% of
system-effect weight that remains mixed under session-level views.
% 在 325 个真实智能体会话上，语义 profiling 分离了会话级视图所混合的超过 90\% 的系统副作用权重。

problems at 9.4\% inspection cost versus flat summaries, with 45\%
fewer groups than fixed-session drilldown.
% 在四个具有隐藏真实标签的公开数据集（34,539 个操作）上，profiler 排序的分组以 9.4\% 的检查成本定位标注问题，比固定会话下钻减少 45\% 的分组数。

content.text:
问题确实存在。论文里三个词混用：

| 词 | 出现次数 | 含义 |
|---|---------|------|
| trace(s) | 52 | 记录的执行数据（observability 术语） |
| session(s) | 59 | 一次 agent 运行/对话 |
| trajectory | 8 | 行为序列（agent/ML 术语） |

**两个标准但来自不同社区的术语：**
- **Observability 社区**：用 "trace"（OpenTelemetry trace = spans 的集合）
- **Agent/ML 社区**：用 "trajectory"（state-action-reward 序列）

**"Session" 的问题：** 这不是任何一个社区的标准 observability 术语。LangSmith/Langfuse 有 session 概念，但 OpenTelemetry 没有。我们用 session 表示 "一次 agent 运行"，但它和 trace 的关系没有定义清楚——一个 session 包含多个 trace？还是一个 session 就是一个 trace？

**"Agent trace" 的问题：** 和 "agent trajectory" 有歧义。在 benchmark 数据集（AgentRewardBench、SATraj-OS 等）里，数据叫 "trajectory"。在 observability 工具里叫 "trace"。论文两个词都用，但没有说明它们的关系。

**建议：** 在 background 或 intro 里加一句定义 session 和 trace 的关系，比如 "a session is one agent run that produces a trace of operations"。但这是 background 的改动，不是 intro/abstract 的问题。当前 abstract/intro 的用法（"agent traces" = 记录的数据, "sessions" = agent 运行的单位）在上下文中是可理解的，不需要立即改。

你觉得需要现在处理还是后面 background 里定义？

想了想，不完全好。两个词有不同含义：

**Trajectory** = agent 的行为序列（做了什么）— agent/ML 社区标准术语
**Trace** = 记录的可观测数据（怎么被记录的）— observability 社区标准术语

本文横跨两个社区。当谈 agent 做了什么（benchmark 数据、eval）时，trajectory 更准确。当谈 observability 工具和数据格式（OpenTelemetry、span tree）时，trace 是标准术语。

**Session** 是真正应该去掉的——它不是任何社区的标准术语，而且和 trajectory 含义重叠（都指 "一次 agent 运行"）。

建议：
- **"session" → "trajectory"**：一次 agent 运行的行为记录
- **"trace" 保留**：仅用于 observability 技术语境（span tree, trace tools, tracing）
- **"agent traces" → "agent trajectories"**：当指 agent 行为数据时

这样 abstract 会变成：
```
S1: ...across hundreds of trajectories.
S5: ...agent trajectories lack...
S8: On 325 real agent trajectories...
```

但 ¶3 existing tools 里保留 "traces"：
```
"Laminar extracts structured signals from traces"
```

因为那里说的是 observability 工具对 trace 数据的处理。

先改 abstract + intro 还是全文一起改？这个改动影响面很大（session 59 次 + 部分 trace 52 次）。

content.text:
在 agent/ML 社区里，**trajectory** 是一个 agent 执行任务的完整行为序列：

> (state₀, action₀, observation₁, action₁, observation₂, ... , actionₙ, result)

就是 "agent 从接到任务到完成/放弃的全过程记录"。

论文引用的 benchmark 数据集（AgentRewardBench、SATraj-OS、AgentNet）都用 "trajectory" 这个词。SWE-agent 叫 "issue trajectories"，TrajAD 名字就带 "Traj"。

和我们的术语对比：
- **trajectory** ≈ 我们说的 "session"（一次 agent 运行）
- **trace** ≈ trajectory 被 observability 工具记录后的数据格式

所以 "agent trajectory" 的含义比 "agent trace" 更贴近我们的使用场景——我们 profile 的对象是 agent 的**行为序列**，不是 OpenTelemetry 格式的 span 数据。

但反过来想，论文的 target venue 是 **SOSP workshop**（systems 社区），systems 读者更熟悉 "trace" 而不是 "trajectory"。而且 "trace" 在 abstract 里还出现在 "debugging and tracing" 这个标准 observability 三元组中，改成 "trajectory" 会打破这个习惯用法。

你倾向哪边？还是保持现状（session 指运行单位，trace 指记录数据）？

content.text:
你说得对，不好。想清楚了：

**Session 不应该去掉。** Session 和 trajectory 不是同义词：

- **Session** = 一次 agent 运行的**边界/容器**（Claude 打开一个 session，做完关掉）
- **Trajectory** = 这次运行里的**行为序列**（state-action-observation 链）

一个 session **产生**一个 trajectory。Session 是运行单位，trajectory 是数据。

论文里 session 的使用场景也确实是指"运行边界"：
- "325 sessions" = 325 次运行
- "cross-session aggregation" = 跨运行聚合
- "per-session span tree" = 每次运行一棵树
- "session field in stack" = 用运行边界作为聚合维度

这些都说的是**边界**，换成 trajectory 反而不对（"cross-trajectory aggregation" 语义不清）。

**结论：保持现状。**
- **Session** = 运行单位/边界（保留）
- **Trace** = observability 语境下的记录数据（保留）
- **Trajectory** = 仅在引用 benchmark 数据集时使用（已经是这样）

不需要统一。三个词各有各的位置。

27	%% S1: Context (→¶1)
28	AI agents increasingly orchestrate long-running, multi-step

43	%% S4: Gap (→¶2+¶3)

45	tracing instead of profiling.

47	%% S5: Agent challenge (→¶4)
48	Agent behavior differs fundamentally from code execution.
49	The responsible entities are semantic categories such as task intent
50	and workflow phase, not code paths, and agent trajectories lack the
51	deterministic identifiers and structural hierarchies that make
52	aggregation possible.

55	We propose a \emph{semantic operation stack model}.

57	\emph{operation stacks} replace the runtime call stack with
58	query-time field projections that fold identical frame sequences.
59	% 我们提出语义 operation stack 模型。统一的 operation 表示所有智能体活动，operation stack 用查询时字段投影替代运行时调用栈，折叠相同帧序列。

62	for \emph{intent attribution} and \emph{stack construction},

80	\label{sec:intro}
81	
82	%% ¶1: Background + context
83	AI agents orchestrate multi-step activities that span two
84	layers, high-level intent (prompts, LLM calls, tool invocations) and
85	low-level system effects (process spawns, file and network I/O).
86	% AI 智能体编排跨越两层的多步骤活动：高层意图（提示词、LLM 调用、工具调用）和低层系统副作用（进程创建、文件和网络 I/O）。
87	As agents evolve from short, scripted workflows into complex systems
88	that run for hours and days, with a large number of interactions each, production
89	teams accumulate many such trajectories over weeks or months.

93	To improve agent quality, safety, and cost efficiency, developers
94	need to analyze operational behavior across trajectories and
95	interactions.
96	Which categories of tasks consume the most token budget? Where do
97	failures concentrate across workflows? Which behavioral patterns
98	trigger unsafe system effects?
99	% 为了提高智能体质量、安全性和成本效率，开发者需要跨轨迹和交互分析运维行为。哪类任务消耗最多 token 预算？故障跨工作流集中在哪里？哪些行为模式触发不安全系统副作用？
100	Answering these questions requires analysis and evaluation across many
101	trajectories, a task too costly for manual inspection or
102	per-trajectory LLM evaluation~\cite{llm-as-judge}.
103	% 回答这些问题需要跨许多轨迹的分析和评估，人工检查或逐轨迹 LLM 评估的成本太高。
104	In traditional systems software, profiling answers these questions by
105	attributing resource consumption to responsible entities by
106	aggregation, as distinct from single-execution debugging and tracing.
107	% 在传统系统软件中，profiling 通过聚合将资源消耗归因到负责实体来回答这些问题，区别于单次执行调试和 tracing。
108	
109	%% ¶3: Existing solutions
110	Existing agent tools support debugging and tracing but not profiling.
111	% 现有智能体工具支持调试和 tracing，但不支持 profiling。
112	LangSmith~\cite{langsmith}, Langfuse~\cite{langfuse},
113	Phoenix~\cite{phoenix}, and OpenTelemetry GenAI~\cite{otel} organize
114	events into per-session span trees, effective for diagnosing a single
115	run but unable to aggregate by semantic category.
116	% LangSmith~\cite{langsmith}、Langfuse~\cite{langfuse}、Phoenix~\cite{phoenix} 和 OpenTelemetry GenAI~\cite{otel} 将事件组织为按会话的 span 树，有效诊断单次运行但无法按语义类别跨会话聚合。
117	Datadog LLM Observability~\cite{datadog-llmobs} clusters user
118	messages by topic, and Laminar~\cite{laminar-signals} extracts
119	structured signals from traces, but both characterize \emph{input
120	distributions} (``30\% of users ask code questions'') rather than
121	\emph{resource attribution} (``review tasks consume 40\% of the

% Operation stack 分析在前五组中检查 9.4\% 的工作量，在 30\% 检查预算内恢复 39.0\% 的正例，并将组数减少到 157.5。

On localization, operation stacks improve top-five recall over per-session on 5/6 tasks, reduce median group count by 45\%, and save 90\% of inspection work versus flat summaries.

content.content:
\begin{abstract}
AI agents increasingly orchestrate long-running, multi-step
activities involving thousands to millions of interactions with
users, tools, and system resources.
To improve quality, safety, and cost efficiency, developers need to
determine which task categories consume the most budget, where
failures concentrate, and which workflows trigger unsafe effects.
To answer similar questions in traditional systems software, profiling
attributes resource consumption to responsible entities, such as code
paths, by aggregation, rather than single-execution debugging or
tracing.
Yet existing agent observability tools are mainly for debugging and
tracing instead of profiling.
Agent behavior differs fundamentally from code execution.
The responsible entities are semantic categories such as task intent
and workflow phase, not code paths, and agent trajectories lack the
deterministic identifiers and structural hierarchies that make
aggregation possible.
We propose a \emph{semantic operation stack model}.
Uniform \emph{operations} represent all agent activities, and
\emph{operation stacks} replace the runtime call stack with
query-time field projections that fold identical frame sequences.
\sys implements this model as a profiler with pluggable algorithms
for \emph{intent attribution} and \emph{stack construction},
compiling local agent trajectories into pprof-compatible profiles.
On real trajectories and public datasets, our evaluation shows that
semantic profiling can help attribute cost and locate problems with
lower cost.
\end{abstract}

\maketitle

content.content:
AI agents orchestrate multi-step activities that span two
layers, high-level intent (prompts, LLM calls, tool invocations) and
low-level system effects (process spawns, file and network I/O).
As agents evolve from short, scripted workflows into complex systems
that run for hours and days, with a large number of interactions each, production
teams accumulate many such trajectories over weeks or months.
To improve agent quality, safety, and cost efficiency, developers
need to analyze operational behavior across trajectories and
interactions.
Which categories of tasks consume the most token budget? Where do
failures concentrate across workflows? Which behavioral patterns
trigger unsafe system effects?
Answering these questions requires analysis and evaluation across many
trajectories, a task becoming costly for manual inspection or
per-trajectory LLM evaluation~\cite{llm-as-judge} at scale.
In traditional systems software, profiling answers these questions by
attributing resource consumption to responsible entities by
aggregation, as distinct from single-execution debugging and tracing.
Yet existing agent tools support debugging and tracing but not
profiling.
LangSmith~\cite{langsmith}, Langfuse~\cite{langfuse},
Phoenix~\cite{phoenix}, and OpenTelemetry GenAI~\cite{otel} organize
events into per-session span trees, effective for diagnosing a single
run but unable to aggregate by semantic category.
Datadog LLM Observability~\cite{datadog-llmobs} clusters user
messages by topic, and Laminar~\cite{laminar-signals} extracts
structured signals from traces, but both characterize \emph{input
distributions} (``30\% of users ask code questions'') rather than
\emph{resource attribution} (``review tasks consume 40\% of the
token budget''), because labels at the request level do not propagate
to downstream tool calls and system effects.
Adapting profiling to agent trajectories is challenging
(\S\ref{sec:background}).
In traditional software, the responsible entities are code paths.
Profiling is straightforward because function names are
deterministic and runtime call nesting provides the aggregation
hierarchy, and flame graphs~\cite{flamegraphs} and pprof~\cite{pprof} call graphs visualize the result.
Agent behavior differs fundamentally.
To answer the questions above, the responsible entities need to be
semantic categories such as task intent and tool operation, not code
paths.
Agent trajectories also lack the two properties that make aggregation possible.
Prompts are natural language, and two prompts expressing the same intent share no common string.
Framework-level span names (\texttt{LLMCall}, \texttt{ToolInvoke}) describe mechanisms, not semantic intent.
Agent events have no runtime call-stack hierarchy because prompts,
tool calls, and system effects are not nested by execution the way
function calls produce stack frames.
\begin{figure*}[t]
\centering
\includegraphics[width=\linewidth,height=2.6cm,keepaspectratio]{figures/flamegraph-tokens.png}\\[2pt]
\includegraphics[width=\linewidth,height=2.6cm,keepaspectratio]{figures/flamegraph-time.png}\\[2pt]
\includegraphics[width=\linewidth,height=2.6cm,keepaspectratio]{figures/flamegraph-files.png}
\caption{Semantic flame graphs of 325 real agent trajectories under
three views. \emph{Top (tokens):} width represents token count.
\emph{Middle (time):} width represents wall-clock duration.
\emph{Bottom (files):} width represents file-operation count.
All three are produced from the same operations by changing only the
stack fields and weight function (Table~\ref{tab:views}).}
\Description{Three wide flame graphs showing token budget, time, and
file-access distributions across sessions and prompt categories.}
\label{fig:flamegraph}
\end{figure*}
Despite these differences, the fundamental profiling
methodology (define units, assign stable labels, construct
aggregation hierarchies, fold identical stacks) transfers to agent
trajectories.
We propose a \emph{semantic operation stack model} with two
components.
\emph{Operations} are uniform records with string fields and
additive measures that represent all agent activities (prompts, LLM
calls, tool invocations, and system effects) without type-specific
objects.
\emph{Operation stacks} are ordered lists of fields chosen at query
time.
Each operation is projected to a frame sequence, and operations
with identical sequences merge, producing the folded-stack
representation that flame graphs visualize
(Figure~\ref{fig:flamegraph}).
Different field selections answer different questions (by task
category, by execution phase, by session, or by action type) from
the same data.
We implement this model in \sys, an offline profiler that compiles
local agent trajectories into pprof-compatible profiles
(Figure~\ref{fig:architecture}).
Two pluggable algorithm frameworks enrich the model.
\emph{Intent attribution} derives deterministic, low-cardinality labels from natural-language fields via regex rules, a local LLM tagger, or unsupervised clustering.
This restores the folding precondition that CPU profiling obtains for free from function names.
\emph{Stack construction} builds aggregation hierarchies from
available fields, either from a user-specified ordered list of fields or via
automatic induction that scores semantic shifts and partition
coherence.
On 325 real Codex and Claude trajectories (183{,}714 system
observations), semantic profiling separates over 90\% of
system-effect cost that per-session views cannot attribute to task
categories.
On four public datasets with hidden ground-truth labels
(34{,}539 operations), profiler-ranked groups localize labeled
problems at 9.4\% inspection cost versus flat summaries, with 45\%
fewer groups than per-session grouping.
Semantic-label quality exceeds V-measure 0.7 on 7 of 9 held-out datasets.
This paper makes three contributions:
\begin{enumerate}
\item \textbf{Semantic operation stack model.}
  We identify the missing profiling layer in agent observability and
  propose a model of uniform operations and query-time operation
  stacks (\S\ref{sec:background}--\S\ref{sec:design}).
\item \textbf{System: \sys.}

content.text:
我们的 claim 层次：

**核心 claim（一句话）：**

> Agent observability 需要 profiling（resource attribution by aggregation），传统 profiling 方法论可以通过 semantic operation stack model 适配到 agent trajectories。

**支撑 claim：**

1. **Gap exists**：现有 agent 工具只有 debugging 和 tracing，没有 profiling
2. **Adaptation is non-trivial**：归因对象不同（semantic categories vs code paths）+ agent trajectories 缺少确定性标识和结构层次
3. **Model works**：operations + operation stacks 提供了统一单元和查询时聚合层次
4. **Algorithms work**：intent attribution 恢复稳定标签，stack construction 构建聚合层次
5. **Evidence**：
   - 分离 90%+ 的 system-effect cost
   - 9.4% 检查成本定位真实问题
   - 7/9 数据集标签质量一致

**但我觉得有个问题：** 我们的 claim 到底是说 "profiling methodology **可以**迁移" 还是说 "profiling methodology **应该**迁移，而且我们的具体 model 是**对的**方式"？

现在的论文更像前者（可行性论证），不是后者（optimality 论证）。对于 workshop paper 这个定位是合适的——我们在说 "这个方向 work"，不是 "这是最优方案"。

你觉得 claim 的力度对吗？还是想调整？

message.content: 我们 eval 了哪些? "profiling methodology 应该迁移，而且我们的具体 model 是对的方式" 这个我们能 claim 吗

content.text:
想想我们 eval 了什么：

**RQ1**：semantic profiling 分离了 90%+ 的 system-effect cost → 证明 **semantic labels 有用**（per-session grouping 做不到）

**RQ2**：profiler groups 以 9.4% 检查成本定位真实问题 → 证明 **profiler output 对应真实问题**（比 flat summary 和 per-session grouping 好）

**RQ3**：derived labels 在 7/9 数据集上与 ground truth 一致 → 证明 **label 质量可靠**

**RQ4**（如果有）：profiling cost

**我们能 claim "应该迁移"吗？** 可以。RQ1 直接证明了 per-session views 不够用，semantic profiling 能做到 per-session 做不到的事。这就是 "应该" 的 evidence。

**我们能 claim "我们的 model 是对的方式"吗？** 部分能。我们证明了：
- operations 能统一表示所有 agent 活动 → RQ1（15 个数据集家族都能表示）
- operation stacks 比 flat grouping 和 per-session grouping 都好 → RQ2（多个 stack 粒度的比较）
- intent attribution 产生可靠标签 → RQ3

**但没有证明的是：** 我们的 model 比其他可能的 model（如果有的话）更好。不过因为目前没有其他 agent profiling model，"这是第一个 work 的方式" 本身就是贡献。

所以 claim 可以是：

> Agent observability needs profiling. We show that the traditional profiling methodology can be adapted through a semantic operation stack model, and demonstrate that this model effectively attributes cost and locates problems across real agent trajectories and public benchmarks.

"Effectively" 而不是 "optimally"。对 workshop paper 来说这个力度合适。要按这个调 abstract/intro 吗？

Background 的意义是**给读者补充他们需要但 intro 没空展开的前置知识**，让他们能看懂 design section。

Intro 告诉读者 **what and why**（问题是什么、为什么重要）。Background 告诉读者 **how things work today**（现有的概念/机制/工具是怎么运作的），让读者有足够的知识来理解后面的 design。

对这篇论文来说，读者在进入 §3 Design 之前需要知道：
1. Agent trajectory 里实际有什么（prompts, LLM calls, tool invocations, system effects）— 读者需要知道数据长什么样
2. 传统 profiling 具体怎么 work（sample → call stack → fold → flame graph）— 读者需要知道我们在 adapt 什么
3. 为什么 per-session grouping 和 span-name grouping 不够用（具体的 gap）— 读者需要知道为什么不能简单解决
4. R1/R2/R3 — 从 gaps 推出的 design requirements，直接对接 §3

其中 1 和 2，intro 已经说了大部分。Background 应该只**补充 intro 没展开的技术细节**，不重复 intro 已经说的。

所以 §2 应该保留的是：
- **Pprof tagroot/tagleaf 为什么不行**（intro 没提）
- **三个 concrete gaps**（intro 只说了 "tools support debugging and tracing but not profiling"，没展开具体为什么）
- **R1/R2/R3**（从 gaps 推出 requirements，对接 design）

§2.1 和 §2.2 的大部分内容（工具列表、profiling vs debugging 定义、flame graph 解释）intro 已经说了，应该压缩或删掉。

% 栈构造。
Stack construction builds aggregation hierarchies from
available fields.
% 栈构造从可用字段构建聚合层次。
When users supply a ordered list of fields, the projection is direct.
% 当用户提供有序字段列表时，投影是直接的。
When no chain is supplied, \sys can induce operation stacks
automatically by scoring adjacent operations for semantic shifts,
field changes, and partition coherence, then cutting at boundaries
where the evidence is strongest.
% 当不提供有序字段列表时，\sys 可以通过对相邻 operation 评分语义转移、字段变化和分区一致性来自动诱导 operation stack，然后在证据最强的边界处切分。
The induced stacks have variable depth, and a configurable depth cap
controls the granularity.
% 诱导的栈具有可变深度，可配置的深度上限控制粒度。
This mode produces coarser groups than hand-specified stacks but
requires no domain knowledge, making it useful for initial
exploration (\S\ref{sec:eval}).
% 此模式产生比手动指定栈更粗的分组，但不需要领域知识，适用于初始探索（\S\ref{sec:eval}）。

\section{Implementation}
% 实现
\label{sec:impl}

\sys is an offline, post-hoc profiler implemented as a Rust CLI (Figure~\ref{fig:architecture}).
% \sys 是一个离线、事后分析器，实现为 Rust CLI（Figure~\ref{fig:architecture}）。
It reads recorded traces, not live events.
% 它读取记录的 trace，而非实时事件。
The \texttt{agent-session} crate reads Codex and Claude Code local JSONL history files and reconstructs prompts, LLM calls, tool invocations, and their triggered file and network effects.

Each prompt opens a span.
% 每个提示词打开一个 span。

Public benchmark datasets enter as operation JSONL with mapping rules deriving fields before stack construction.
% 公开基准数据集以 operation JSONL 形式进入，映射规则在栈构建之前派生字段。

244	\subsection{AI Agent Observability}
245	% AI 智能体可观测性
246	
247	As introduced in \S\ref{sec:intro}, agent activities span both intent and system-effect layers.
248	% 如 \S\ref{sec:intro} 所述，智能体活动跨越意图层和系统副作用层。
249	Existing observability tools~\cite{agentops,agenttelemetry} cover these layers separately.
250	% 现有可观测性工具~\cite{agentops,agenttelemetry}分别覆盖这两层。
251	LangSmith~\cite{langsmith}, Langfuse~\cite{langfuse}, Phoenix~\cite{phoenix}, and OpenTelemetry GenAI~\cite{otel} organize agent-level events into per-execution \emph{span trees}.
252	% LangSmith~\cite{langsmith}、Langfuse~\cite{langfuse}、Phoenix~\cite{phoenix} 和 OpenTelemetry GenAI~\cite{otel} 将智能体级事件组织为按执行划分的 span 树。
253	System monitors show process and file activity without semantic attribution.
254	% 系统监控器显示进程和文件活动，但没有语义归因。
255	The span-tree design is effective for debugging.

322	Sessions and spans must be fields, not fixed hierarchy nodes.
323	% 会话和 span 必须是字段，而非固定层次节点。

326	% 自由形式的提示词必须在折叠前映射为短小、稳定、可重复的标签。

328	% 这一意图识别步骤在 CPU 性能分析中没有对应物，因为函数名已经是确定性的。
329	\end{description}

\subsection{AI Agent Observability}
% AI 智能体可观测性

A typical agent trajectory interleaves two layers of activity.
% 典型的智能体轨迹交织两层活动。
At the intent layer, the agent receives a user prompt, issues LLM
calls, and invokes tools (code execution, web search, file editing).
% 在意图层，智能体接收用户提示词、发出 LLM 调用并调用工具（代码执行、网络搜索、文件编辑）。
Each tool invocation triggers system effects at the lower layer:
process spawns, file reads and writes, and network requests.
% 每次工具调用在下层触发系统副作用：进程创建、文件读写和网络请求。
A single trajectory may contain hundreds of such intent-effect cycles,
and a production team accumulates many trajectories over time.
% 单条轨迹可能包含数百个这样的意图-副作用循环，生产团队随时间积累许多轨迹。
Existing tools~\cite{langsmith,langfuse,phoenix,otel} record these
events as per-execution span trees, effective for debugging a single
run.
% 现有工具~\cite{langsmith,langfuse,phoenix,otel}将这些事件记录为按执行划分的 span 树，有效调试单次运行。
AgentSight~\cite{agentsight} bridges the two layers by correlating
eBPF-captured system events with intercepted LLM traffic, but the
resulting traces still lack aggregate profiling.
% AgentSight~\cite{agentsight} 通过关联 eBPF 捕获的系统事件与拦截的 LLM 流量来桥接两层，但生成的 trace 仍缺乏聚合分析能力。

\subsection{Profiling vs.\ Debugging}
% 性能分析 vs. 调试

As noted in \S\ref{sec:intro}, profiling attributes resource
consumption to responsible entities by aggregation, as distinct from
single-execution debugging and tracing.
% 如 \S\ref{sec:intro} 所述，profiling 通过聚合将资源消耗归因到负责实体，区别于单次执行调试和 tracing。
In traditional software, the profiling pipeline works as follows:
a profiler periodically samples execution state, attaches each sample
to the current call stack, and merges samples with identical stacks.
% 在传统软件中，profiling 管线如下工作：profiler 周期性采样执行状态，将每个样本附加到当前调用栈，合并具有相同栈的样本。
Flame graphs~\cite{flamegraphs} and pprof~\cite{pprof} call graphs
visualize the result, where width or node size represents aggregate
cost.
% 火焰图~\cite{flamegraphs}和 pprof~\cite{pprof} 调用图可视化其结果，宽度或节点大小代表聚合开销。
Perfetto~\cite{perfetto} generalizes this with SQL-based analysis and
derived events.
% Perfetto~\cite{perfetto} 通过基于 SQL 的分析和衍生事件进行泛化。
These tools support flexible aggregation, but they all assume
deterministic function names and a runtime call stack.
% 这些工具支持灵活聚合，但都假设确定性函数名和运行时调用栈。
Pprof's \texttt{tagroot}/\texttt{tagleaf} options can add
label-derived pseudo-frames, but only on top of an existing execution
stack that agent activities do not have.
% Pprof 的 \texttt{tagroot}/\texttt{tagleaf} 选项可以添加标签衍生的伪帧，但仅在智能体活动不具备的已有执行栈之上。

\subsection{AI Agent Observability}
% AI 智能体可观测性

As introduced in \S\ref{sec:intro}, agent activities span both intent and system-effect layers.
% 如 \S\ref{sec:intro} 所述，智能体活动跨越意图层和系统副作用层。
Existing observability tools~\cite{agentops,agenttelemetry} cover these layers separately.
% 现有可观测性工具~\cite{agentops,agenttelemetry}分别覆盖这两层。
LangSmith~\cite{langsmith}, Langfuse~\cite{langfuse}, Phoenix~\cite{phoenix}, and OpenTelemetry GenAI~\cite{otel} organize agent-level events into per-execution \emph{span trees}.
% LangSmith~\cite{langsmith}、Langfuse~\cite{langfuse}、Phoenix~\cite{phoenix} 和 OpenTelemetry GenAI~\cite{otel} 将智能体级事件组织为按执行划分的 span 树。
System monitors show process and file activity without semantic attribution.
% 系统监控器显示进程和文件活动，但没有语义归因。
The span-tree design is effective for debugging.
% span 树设计对调试是有效的。
A developer can locate a failing span, inspect its attributes, and trace its parent chain.
% 开发者可以定位失败的 span、检查其属性并追踪其父链。
AgentSight~\cite{agentsight} bridges the two layers by correlating eBPF-captured system events with intercepted LLM traffic, but the resulting traces still lack aggregate profiling.
% AgentSight~\cite{agentsight} 通过关联 eBPF 捕获的系统事件与拦截的 LLM 流量来桥接两层，但生成的 trace 仍缺乏聚合分析能力。

\subsection{Profiling vs.\ Debugging}
% 性能分析 vs. 调试

Debugging inspects a single execution, but profiling aggregates across executions to answer questions like ``where does the budget go?''
% 调试检查单次执行，而性能分析跨执行聚合以回答"预算花在哪里？"等问题。
CPU profilers solved this aggregation problem decades ago.
% CPU 分析器几十年前就解决了这个聚合问题。
A flame graph~\cite{flamegraphs} represents a profile as weighted \emph{samples}, each attached to a \emph{call stack}.
% 火焰图~\cite{flamegraphs}将性能概要表示为加权样本，每个样本附带一个调用栈。
Identical stacks merge, and width represents aggregate cost.
% 相同的栈合并，宽度代表聚合开销。
The key enabler is \emph{deterministic} function names, so the same code path always produces the same frames.
% 关键条件是确定性的函数名，使相同代码路径始终产生相同的栈帧。

Agent activities break this precondition in two ways.
% 智能体活动从两方面打破了这一前提。
First, prompts are natural language and lack deterministic identifiers.
% 第一，提示词是自然语言，缺乏确定性标识符。
Second, agent events have no inherent call stack because they lack the runtime-determined parent-child nesting that function calls provide.
% 第二，智能体事件没有固有的调用栈，因为它们缺乏函数调用提供的运行时确定的父子嵌套关系。
Pprof's~\cite{pprof} \texttt{tagroot}/\texttt{tagleaf} options add label-derived pseudo-frames to an existing execution stack, but agent activities have no execution stack to augment.
% Pprof~\cite{pprof} 的 \texttt{tagroot}/\texttt{tagleaf} 选项在已有执行栈上添加标签衍生的伪帧，但智能体活动没有执行栈可供扩展。

\subsection{The Aggregation Gap}
% 聚合缺口

Existing agent observability tools~\cite{langsmith,langfuse,phoenix,otel,datadog-llmobs} are designed for debugging, not profiling, and this creates three concrete gaps.

\subsection{AI Agent Observability}
% AI 智能体可观测性

A typical agent trajectory interleaves two layers of activity.
% 典型的智能体轨迹交织两层活动。
At the intent layer, the agent receives a user prompt, issues LLM
calls, and invokes tools (code execution, web search, file editing).
% 在意图层，智能体接收用户提示词、发出 LLM 调用并调用工具（代码执行、网络搜索、文件编辑）。
Each tool invocation triggers system effects at the lower layer:
process spawns, file reads and writes, and network requests.
% 每次工具调用在下层触发系统副作用：进程创建、文件读写和网络请求。
A single trajectory may contain hundreds of such intent-effect
cycles, and a production team accumulates many trajectories over
time.
% 单条轨迹可能包含数百个这样的意图-副作用循环，生产团队随时间积累许多轨迹。
Existing tools~\cite{langsmith,langfuse,phoenix,otel} record these
events as per-execution span trees, effective for debugging a single
run.
% 现有工具~\cite{langsmith,langfuse,phoenix,otel}将这些事件记录为按执行划分的 span 树，有效调试单次运行。
AgentSight~\cite{agentsight} bridges the two layers by correlating
eBPF-captured system events with intercepted LLM traffic, but the
resulting traces still lack aggregate profiling.
% AgentSight~\cite{agentsight} 通过关联 eBPF 捕获的系统事件与拦截的 LLM 流量来桥接两层，但生成的 trace 仍缺乏聚合分析能力。

\subsection{Profiling vs.\ Debugging}
% 性能分析 vs. 调试

As noted in \S\ref{sec:intro}, profiling attributes resource
consumption to responsible entities by aggregation, as distinct from
single-execution debugging and tracing.
% 如 \S\ref{sec:intro} 所述，profiling 通过聚合将资源消耗归因到负责实体，区别于单次执行调试和 tracing。
In traditional software, the profiling pipeline works as follows:
a profiler periodically samples execution state, attaches each
sample to the current call stack, and merges samples with identical
stacks.
% 在传统软件中，profiling 管线如下工作：profiler 周期性采样执行状态，将每个样本附加到当前调用栈，合并具有相同栈的样本。
Flame graphs~\cite{flamegraphs} and pprof~\cite{pprof} call graphs
visualize the result, where width or node size represents aggregate
cost.
% 火焰图~\cite{flamegraphs}和 pprof~\cite{pprof} 调用图可视化其结果，宽度或节点大小代表聚合开销。
Perfetto~\cite{perfetto} generalizes this with SQL-based analysis
and derived events.
% Perfetto~\cite{perfetto} 通过基于 SQL 的分析和衍生事件进行泛化。
These tools support flexible aggregation, but they all assume
deterministic function names and a runtime call stack.
% 这些工具支持灵活聚合，但都假设确定性函数名和运行时调用栈。
Pprof's \texttt{tagroot}/\texttt{tagleaf} options can add
label-derived pseudo-frames, but only on top of an existing execution
stack that agent trajectories do not have.
% Pprof 的 \texttt{tagroot}/\texttt{tagleaf} 选项可以添加标签衍生的伪帧，但仅在智能体轨迹不具备的已有执行栈之上。

248	% 典型的智能体轨迹交织两层活动。

250	calls, and invokes tools (code execution, web search, file editing).

254	% 每次工具调用在下层触发系统副作用：进程创建、文件读写和网络请求。
255	A single trajectory may contain hundreds of such intent-effect

\subsection{AI Agent Observability}
% AI 智能体可观测性

A typical agent trajectory interleaves two layers of activity.
% 典型的智能体轨迹交织两层活动。
At the intent layer, the agent receives a user prompt, issues LLM
calls, and invokes tools (code execution, web search, file editing).
% 在意图层，智能体接收用户提示词、发出 LLM 调用并调用工具（代码执行、网络搜索、文件编辑）。
Each tool invocation triggers system effects at the lower layer:
process spawns, file reads and writes, and network requests.
% 每次工具调用在下层触发系统副作用：进程创建、文件读写和网络请求。
A single trajectory may contain hundreds of such intent-effect
cycles, and a production team accumulates many trajectories over
time.
% 单条轨迹可能包含数百个这样的意图-副作用循环，生产团队随时间积累许多轨迹。
Existing tools~\cite{langsmith,langfuse,phoenix,otel} record these
events as per-execution span trees, effective for debugging a single
run.
% 现有工具~\cite{langsmith,langfuse,phoenix,otel}将这些事件记录为按执行划分的 span 树，有效调试单次运行。
AgentSight~\cite{agentsight} bridges the two layers by correlating
eBPF-captured system events with intercepted LLM traffic, but the
resulting traces still lack aggregate profiling.
% AgentSight~\cite{agentsight} 通过关联 eBPF 捕获的系统事件与拦截的 LLM 流量来桥接两层，但生成的 trace 仍缺乏聚合分析能力。

\subsection{Profiling vs.\ Debugging}
% 性能分析 vs. 调试

As noted in \S\ref{sec:intro}, profiling attributes resource
consumption to responsible entities by aggregation, as distinct from
single-execution debugging and tracing.
% 如 \S\ref{sec:intro} 所述，profiling 通过聚合将资源消耗归因到负责实体，区别于单次执行调试和 tracing。
In traditional software, the profiling pipeline works as follows:
a profiler periodically samples execution state, attaches each
sample to the current call stack, and merges samples with identical
stacks.
% 在传统软件中，profiling 管线如下工作：profiler 周期性采样执行状态，将每个样本附加到当前调用栈，合并具有相同栈的样本。
Flame graphs~\cite{flamegraphs} and pprof~\cite{pprof} call graphs
visualize the result, where width or node size represents aggregate
cost.
% 火焰图~\cite{flamegraphs}和 pprof~\cite{pprof} 调用图可视化其结果，宽度或节点大小代表聚合开销。
Perfetto~\cite{perfetto} generalizes this with SQL-based analysis
and derived events.
% Perfetto~\cite{perfetto} 通过基于 SQL 的分析和衍生事件进行泛化。
These tools support flexible aggregation, but they all assume
deterministic function names and a runtime call stack.
% 这些工具支持灵活聚合，但都假设确定性函数名和运行时调用栈。
Pprof's \texttt{tagroot}/\texttt{tagleaf} options can add
label-derived pseudo-frames, but only on top of an existing execution
stack that agent trajectories do not have.
% Pprof 的 \texttt{tagroot}/\texttt{tagleaf} 选项可以添加标签衍生的伪帧，但仅在智能体轨迹不具备的已有执行栈之上。

\subsection{The Aggregation Gap}
% 聚合缺口

Existing agent observability tools~\cite{langsmith,langfuse,phoenix,otel,datadog-llmobs} are designed for debugging, not profiling, and this creates three concrete gaps.
% 现有智能体可观测性工具~\cite{langsmith,langfuse,phoenix,otel,datadog-llmobs}为调试而设计，而非性能分析，这造成了三个具体缺口。

First, sessions are boundaries, not categories.
% 第一，会话是边界，不是类别。
A single session may contain review, debugging, and refactoring phases, and splitting by session assigns all of them to the same bucket.
% 单个会话可能包含 review、debugging 和 refactoring 阶段，按会话拆分会将它们全部分配到同一桶中。
Two sessions performing the same task produce separate buckets that cannot be merged without external logic.
% 执行相同任务的两个会话会产生无法在没有外部逻辑的情况下合并的分离桶。

Second, span names~\cite{otel,openinference} describe mechanisms (\texttt{LLMCall}, \texttt{ToolInvoke}, \texttt{ChatCompletion}), not user intent (\texttt{review}, \texttt{debug}, \texttt{test}).
% 第二，span 名称~\cite{otel,openinference}描述机制（\texttt{LLMCall}、\texttt{ToolInvoke}、\texttt{ChatCompletion}），而非用户意图（\texttt{review}、\texttt{debug}、\texttt{test}）。
Grouping by span name tells you how many LLM calls occurred, not which categories of work consumed the budget.
% 按 span 名称分组只能告诉你发生了多少次 LLM 调用，而非哪些工作类别消耗了预算。

Third, these limitations compound in practice.
% 第三，这些限制在实践中叠加放大。
A common system effect like running a test suite may appear thousands of times across sessions, but a flat summary shows only a single counter with no way to attribute executions to the semantic intent that triggered them.
% 像运行测试套件这样的常见系统副作用可能在会话中出现数千次，但扁平摘要只显示一个计数器，无法将执行归因到触发它们的语义意图。
We quantify this in RQ1~(\S\ref{sec:eval}).
% 我们在 RQ1~(\S\ref{sec:eval}) 中量化了这一点。

These observations yield three design requirements:
% 这些观察得出三个设计需求：

\begin{description}
\item[R1: Uniform record type.]
Agent activities mix prompts, LLM calls, tool invocations, GUI actions, process events, and benchmark labels.
% 智能体活动混合了提示词、LLM 调用、工具调用、GUI 操作、进程事件和基准标签。
The profiler needs a single record type that can represent all of them without type-specific objects.
% 分析器需要一种能表示所有这些活动的单一记录类型，无需特定类型的对象。
\item[R2: Query-time aggregation.]
The same data must support multiple aggregation shapes (by task, phase, action, session, or dataset) without rebuilding the input.
% 同一数据必须支持多种聚合形状（按任务、阶段、操作、会话或数据集），无需重建输入。
Sessions and spans must be fields, not fixed hierarchy nodes.
% 会话和 span 必须是字段，而非固定层次节点。

% Datadog LLM Observability~\cite{datadog-llmobs} 和 Laminar~\cite{laminar-signals} 通过聚类用户消息或提取结构化事件向语义聚合迈进，但它们刻画的是输入分布而非资源归因。

Three lines of work are most relevant.
% 三个方向的工作最为相关。

\paragraph{Agent observability tools.}
% 智能体可观测性工具。
LangSmith~\cite{langsmith}, Langfuse~\cite{langfuse},
Phoenix~\cite{phoenix}, OpenTelemetry GenAI~\cite{otel},
OpenInference~\cite{openinference},
AgentOps~\cite{agentops}, and
AgentTelemetry~\cite{agenttelemetry} provide span-tree debugging,
session management, and fault-type taxonomies.
% LangSmith~\cite{langsmith}、Langfuse~\cite{langfuse}、Phoenix~\cite{phoenix}、OpenTelemetry GenAI~\cite{otel}、OpenInference~\cite{openinference}、AgentOps~\cite{agentops} 和 AgentTelemetry~\cite{agenttelemetry} 提供 span 树调试、会话管理和故障类型分类。
Wang et al.~\cite{agenttraces-trust} survey evidence tracing and
execution provenance as foundations for agent accountability.
% Wang et al.~\cite{agenttraces-trust} 综述了证据追踪和执行溯源作为智能体问责的基础。
All focus on single-execution debugging.
% 都聚焦于单次执行调试。
\sys complements them with cross-trajectory aggregate profiling.
% \sys 以跨轨迹聚合 profiling 补充它们。

\paragraph{Semantic aggregation.}
% 语义聚合。
Datadog LLM Observability~\cite{datadog-llmobs} clusters user
messages by topic, and Laminar~\cite{laminar-signals} extracts
structured signals from traces.
% Datadog LLM Observability~\cite{datadog-llmobs} 按主题聚类用户消息，Laminar~\cite{laminar-signals} 从 trace 中提取结构化信号。
Both take steps toward semantic aggregation but characterize
\emph{input distributions} (``30\% of users ask code questions''),
not \emph{resource attribution} (``review tasks consume 40\% of the
token budget''), because labels at the request level do not propagate
to downstream tool calls and system effects.
% 两者都向语义聚合迈进，但刻画的是输入分布（"30\% 的用户提问代码问题"）而非资源归因（"review 任务消耗了 40\% 的 token 预算"），因为请求级的标签不会传播到下游工具调用和系统副作用。

\paragraph{Trajectory analysis.}
% 轨迹分析。
AgentRx~\cite{agentrx} uses constraint checking and an LLM judge
for root-cause localization in failure trajectories.
% AgentRx~\cite{agentrx} 使用约束检查和 LLM 评判在失败轨迹中进行根因定位。
TELBench~\cite{telbench} builds span-localization benchmarks from
semantic error annotations.
% TELBench~\cite{telbench} 从语义错误标注构建 span 定位基准。
AgentAtlas~\cite{agentatlas} argues that outcome leaderboards miss
trajectory-level quality.
% AgentAtlas~\cite{agentatlas} 认为结果排行榜忽略了轨迹级质量。
TrajAD~\cite{trajad} and AgentFixer~\cite{agentfixer} detect
trajectory anomalies and recommend fixes.
% TrajAD~\cite{trajad} 和 AgentFixer~\cite{agentfixer} 检测轨迹异常并推荐修复。
These systems perform span-level or step-level fault localization
within a single execution, while \sys performs category-level
aggregate profiling across trajectories.
% 这些系统在单次执行内执行 span 级或步骤级故障定位，而 \sys 执行跨轨迹的类别级聚合 profiling。

24	\title{AgentProf: Semantic Profiling for AI Agents}
25	
26	\begin{abstract}
27	%% S1: Context (→¶1)
28	AI agents increasingly orchestrate long-running, multi-step
29	activities involving thousands to millions of interactions with
30	users, tools, and system resources.
31	% AI 智能体编排长时间运行的多步骤活动，涉及与用户、工具和系统资源的数千到数百万次交互。
32	%% S2: Need (→¶2)
33	To improve quality, safety, and cost efficiency, developers need to
34	determine which task categories consume the most budget, where
35	failures concentrate, and which workflows trigger unsafe effects.
36	% 为了提高质量、安全性和成本效率，开发者需要确定哪类任务消耗最多预算、故障集中在哪里、哪些工作流触发不安全副作用。
37	%% S3: Traditional profiling (→¶2+¶4)
38	To answer similar questions in traditional systems software, profiling
39	attributes resource consumption to responsible entities, such as code
40	paths, by aggregation, rather than single-execution debugging or
41	tracing.
42	% 在传统系统软件中，profiling 通过聚合将资源消耗归因到负责实体（如代码路径），而非单次执行调试或 tracing。
43	%% S4: Gap (→¶2+¶3)
44	Yet existing agent observability tools are mainly for debugging and
45	tracing instead of profiling.
46	% 然而现有智能体可观测性工具主要用于调试和 tracing，而非 profiling。
47	%% S5: Agent challenge (→¶4)
48	Agent behavior differs fundamentally from code execution.
49	The responsible entities are semantic categories such as task intent
50	and workflow phase, not code paths, and agent trajectories lack the
51	deterministic identifiers and structural hierarchies that make
52	aggregation possible.
53	% 智能体行为与代码执行有根本不同。负责实体是语义类别（如任务意图和工作流阶段），而非代码路径，且智能体轨迹缺乏使聚合成为可能的确定性标识符和结构层次。
54	%% S6: Model (→¶5)
55	We propose the a \emph{semantic operation stack model} that
56	adapts profiling to agent trajectories.
57	Uniform \emph{operations} represent all agent activities, and
58	\emph{operation stacks} replace the runtime call stack with
59	query-time field projections that fold identical frame sequences.
60	% 我们提出首个将 profiling 适配到智能体轨迹的语义 operation stack 模型。统一的 operation 表示所有智能体活动，operation stack 用查询时字段投影替代运行时调用栈，折叠相同帧序列。
61	%% S7: System (→¶6)
62	\sys implements this model as a profiler with pluggable algorithms
63	for \emph{intent attribution} and \emph{stack construction},
64	compiling local agent trajectories into pprof-compatible profiles.
65	% \sys 将此模型实现为具有可插拔意图归因和栈构造算法的 profiler，将本地智能体轨迹编译为 pprof 兼容的 profile。
66	%% S8: Results (→¶6)
67	On real trajectories and public datasets, our evaluation shows that
68	semantic profiling effectively attributes cost and locates problems
69	across agent trajectories.
70	% 在真实轨迹和公开数据集上，我们的评估表明语义 profiling 能有效地跨智能体轨迹归因开销和定位问题。
71	\end{abstract}

75	%% ===================================================================
76	\section{Introduction}
77	\label{sec:intro}
78	
79	%% ¶1: Background + context
80	AI agents~\cite{sweagent,claudecode,osworld} orchestrate multi-step activities that span two layers, high-level intent (prompts, LLM calls, tool invocations) and low-level system effects (process spawns, file and network I/O).
81	% AI 智能体~\cite{sweagent,claudecode,osworld}编排跨越两层的多步骤活动：高层意图（提示词、LLM 调用、工具调用）和低层系统副作用（进程创建、文件和网络 I/O）。
82	As agents evolve from short, scripted workflows into complex systems that run for hours and days, with a large number of interactions each, production teams accumulate many such trajectories over weeks or months.
83	% 随着智能体从短小的脚本化工作流进化为每次运行数小时、包含数千次交互的复杂系统，生产团队在数周或数月内积累大量此类轨迹。
84	
85	%% ¶2: Problem
86	To improve agent quality, safety, and cost efficiency, developers
87	need to analyze operational behavior across trajectories and
88	interactions.
89	Which categories of tasks consume the most token budget? Where do
90	failures concentrate across workflows? Which behavioral patterns
91	trigger unsafe system effects?
92	% 为了提高智能体质量、安全性和成本效率，开发者需要跨轨迹和交互分析运维行为。哪类任务消耗最多 token 预算？故障跨工作流集中在哪里？哪些行为模式触发不安全系统副作用？
93	Answering these questions requires analysis and evaluation across many
94	trajectories~\cite{agentatlas,agentrewardbench}, a task becoming costly for manual inspection or
95	per-trajectory LLM evaluation~\cite{llm-as-judge} at scale.
96	% 回答这些问题需要跨许多轨迹的分析和评估，在规模化时人工检查或逐轨迹 LLM 评估的成本越来越高。
97	In traditional systems software, profiling answers these questions by
98	attributing resource consumption to responsible entities by
99	aggregation, as distinct from single-execution debugging and tracing.
100	% 在传统系统软件中，profiling 通过聚合将资源消耗归因到负责实体来回答这些问题，区别于单次执行调试和 tracing。
101	
102	%% ¶3: Existing solutions
103	Yet existing agent tools support debugging and tracing but not
104	profiling.
105	% 然而现有智能体工具支持调试和 tracing，但不支持 profiling。
106	LangSmith~\cite{langsmith}, Langfuse~\cite{langfuse},
107	Phoenix~\cite{phoenix}, and OpenTelemetry GenAI~\cite{otel} organize
108	events into per-session span trees, effective for diagnosing a single
109	run but unable to aggregate by semantic category.
110	% LangSmith~\cite{langsmith}、Langfuse~\cite{langfuse}、Phoenix~\cite{phoenix} 和 OpenTelemetry GenAI~\cite{otel} 将事件组织为按会话的 span 树，有效诊断单次运行但无法按语义类别跨会话聚合。
111	Datadog LLM Observability~\cite{datadog-llmobs} clusters user
112	messages by topic, and Laminar~\cite{laminar-signals} extracts
113	structured signals from traces, but both characterize \emph{input
114	distributions} (``30\% of users ask code questions'') rather than
115	\emph{resource attribution} (``review tasks consume 40\% of the
116	token budget''), because labels at the request level do not propagate
117	to downstream tool calls and system effects.
118	% Datadog LLM Observability~\cite{datadog-llmobs} 按主题聚类用户消息，Laminar~\cite{laminar-signals} 从 trace 中提取结构化信号，但两者都刻画输入分布（"30\% 的用户提问代码问题"）而非资源归因（"review 任务消耗了 40\% 的 token 预算"），因为请求级的标签不会传播到下游工具调用和系统副作用。
119	
120	%% ¶4: Challenge — why traditional profiling doesn't transfer directly
121	Adapting profiling to agent trajectories is challenging
122	(\S\ref{sec:background}).
123	% 将 profiling 适配到智能体轨迹具有挑战性（\S\ref{sec:background}）。
124	In traditional software, the responsible entities are code paths.
125	Profiling is straightforward because function names are
126	deterministic and runtime call nesting provides the aggregation
127	hierarchy, and flame graphs~\cite{flamegraphs}, pprof~\cite{pprof}, and Perfetto~\cite{perfetto} visualize the result.
128	% 在传统软件中，负责实体是代码路径。Profiling 是直接的，因为函数名是确定性的，运行时调用嵌套提供聚合层次，火焰图~\cite{flamegraphs}可视化其结果。
129	Agent behavior differs fundamentally.
130	To answer the questions above, the responsible entities need to be
131	semantic categories such as task intent and tool operation, not code
132	paths.
133	% 智能体行为有根本不同。要回答上述问题，负责实体需要是语义类别（如任务意图和工具操作），而非代码路径。
134	Agent trajectories also lack the two properties that make aggregation possible.
135	% 智能体轨迹还缺乏使聚合成为可能的两个特性。
136	Prompts are natural language, and two prompts expressing the same intent share no common string.
137	% 提示词是自然语言，表达相同意图的两个提示词没有共同字符串。
138	Framework-level span names (\texttt{LLMCall}, \texttt{ToolInvoke}) describe mechanisms, not semantic intent.
139	% 框架级 span 名称（\texttt{LLMCall}、\texttt{ToolInvoke}）描述机制，而非语义意图。
140	Agent events have no runtime call-stack hierarchy because prompts,
141	tool calls, and system effects are not nested by execution the way
142	function calls produce stack frames.
143	% 智能体事件没有运行时调用栈层次，因为提示词、工具调用和系统副作用不像函数调用那样通过执行嵌套产生栈帧。

Existing agent observability tools are designed for debugging, not
profiling, and this creates three concrete gaps.
% 现有智能体可观测性工具~\cite{langsmith,langfuse,phoenix,otel,datadog-llmobs}为调试而设计，而非性能分析，这造成了三个具体缺口。

First, sessions are boundaries, not categories.
% 第一，会话是边界，不是类别。
A single session may contain review, debugging, and refactoring phases, and splitting by session assigns all of them to the same bucket.
% 单个会话可能包含 review、debugging 和 refactoring 阶段，按会话拆分会将它们全部分配到同一桶中。
Two sessions performing the same task produce separate buckets that cannot be merged without external logic.
% 执行相同任务的两个会话会产生无法在没有外部逻辑的情况下合并的分离桶。

Second, span names~\cite{otel,openinference} describe mechanisms (\texttt{LLMCall}, \texttt{ToolInvoke}, \texttt{ChatCompletion}), not user intent (\texttt{review}, \texttt{debug}, \texttt{test}).
% 第二，span 名称~\cite{otel,openinference}描述机制（\texttt{LLMCall}、\texttt{ToolInvoke}、\texttt{ChatCompletion}），而非用户意图（\texttt{review}、\texttt{debug}、\texttt{test}）。
Grouping by span name tells you how many LLM calls occurred, not which categories of work consumed the budget.
% 按 span 名称分组只能告诉你发生了多少次 LLM 调用，而非哪些工作类别消耗了预算。

Third, these limitations compound in practice.
% 第三，这些限制在实践中叠加放大。
A common system effect like running a test suite may appear thousands of times across sessions, but a flat summary shows only a single counter with no way to attribute executions to the semantic intent that triggered them.
% 像运行测试套件这样的常见系统副作用可能在会话中出现数千次，但扁平摘要只显示一个计数器，无法将执行归因到触发它们的语义意图。
We quantify this in RQ1~(\S\ref{sec:eval}).
% 我们在 RQ1~(\S\ref{sec:eval}) 中量化了这一点。 合并成一段, Existing tools~\cite{langsmith,langfuse,phoenix,otel} record these
events as per-execution span trees, effective for debugging a single
run.
% 现有工具~\cite{langsmith,langfuse,phoenix,otel}将这些事件记录为按执行划分的 span 树，有效调试单次运行。
AgentSight~\cite{agentsight} bridges the two layers by correlating
eBPF-captured system events with intercepted LLM traffic, but the
resulting traces still lack aggregate profiling.
% AgentSight~\cite{agentsight} 通过关联 eBPF 捕获的系统事件与拦截的 LLM 流量来桥接两层，但生成的 trace 仍缺乏聚合分析能力。
 同时关于 system effect 的也不要丢掉啊

268	a profiler periodically samples execution state, attaches each
269	sample to the current call stack, and merges samples with identical
270	stacks.

% 每次工具调用在下层触发系统副作用：进程创建、文件读写和网络请求。
A single trajectory may contain hundreds of such intent-effect
cycles, and a production team accumulates many trajectories over
time.
% 单条轨迹可能包含数百个这样的意图-副作用循环，生产团队随时间积累许多轨迹。

\subsection{System Profiling}
% 系统 Profiling

Profiling attributes resource consumption to responsible entities by
aggregation, as distinct from single-execution debugging and
tracing.
% Profiling 通过聚合将资源消耗归因到负责实体，区别于单次执行调试和 tracing。
In traditional software, the profiling pipeline works as follows:
a profiler periodically samples execution state, attaches each
sample to the current call stack, and merges samples with identical
stacks.
% 在传统软件中，profiling 管线如下工作：profiler 周期性采样执行状态，将每个样本附加到当前调用栈，合并具有相同栈的样本。
Flame graphs~\cite{flamegraphs} and pprof~\cite{pprof} call graphs
visualize the result, where width or node size represents aggregate
cost.
% 火焰图~\cite{flamegraphs}和 pprof~\cite{pprof} 调用图可视化其结果，宽度或节点大小代表聚合开销。
Perfetto~\cite{perfetto} generalizes this with SQL-based analysis
and derived events.
% Perfetto~\cite{perfetto} 通过基于 SQL 的分析和衍生事件进行泛化。
These tools support flexible aggregation, but they all assume
deterministic function names and a runtime call stack.
% 这些工具支持灵活聚合，但都假设确定性函数名和运行时调用栈。
Pprof's \texttt{tagroot}/\texttt{tagleaf} options can add
label-derived pseudo-frames, but only on top of an existing execution
stack that agent trajectories do not have.
% Pprof 的 \texttt{tagroot}/\texttt{tagleaf} 选项可以添加标签衍生的伪帧，但仅在智能体轨迹不具备的已有执行栈之上。

\subsection{The Aggregation Gap for Agents}
% 智能体的聚合缺口

Existing agent observability tools are designed for debugging, not
profiling, and this creates three concrete gaps.
% 现有智能体可观测性工具~\cite{langsmith,langfuse,phoenix,otel,datadog-llmobs}为调试而设计，而非性能分析，这造成了三个具体缺口。

First, sessions are boundaries, not categories.
% 第一，会话是边界，不是类别。
A single session may contain review, debugging, and refactoring phases, and splitting by session assigns all of them to the same bucket.
% 单个会话可能包含 review、debugging 和 refactoring 阶段，按会话拆分会将它们全部分配到同一桶中。
Two sessions performing the same task produce separate buckets that cannot be merged without external logic.
% 执行相同任务的两个会话会产生无法在没有外部逻辑的情况下合并的分离桶。

Second, span names~\cite{otel,openinference} describe mechanisms (\texttt{LLMCall}, \texttt{ToolInvoke}, \texttt{ChatCompletion}), not user intent (\texttt{review}, \texttt{debug}, \texttt{test}).
% 第二，span 名称~\cite{otel,openinference}描述机制（\texttt{LLMCall}、\texttt{ToolInvoke}、\texttt{ChatCompletion}），而非用户意图（\texttt{review}、\texttt{debug}、\texttt{test}）。
Grouping by span name tells you how many LLM calls occurred, not which categories of work consumed the budget.
% 按 span 名称分组只能告诉你发生了多少次 LLM 调用，而非哪些工作类别消耗了预算。

Third, these limitations compound in practice.
% 第三，这些限制在实践中叠加放大。
A common system effect like running a test suite may appear thousands of times across sessions, but a flat summary shows only a single counter with no way to attribute executions to the semantic intent that triggered them.
% 像运行测试套件这样的常见系统副作用可能在会话中出现数千次，但扁平摘要只显示一个计数器，无法将执行归因到触发它们的语义意图。
We quantify this in RQ1~(\S\ref{sec:eval}).
% 我们在 RQ1~(\S\ref{sec:eval}) 中量化了这一点。

\subsection{Design Requirements for Agent Profiling}
% 智能体 Profiling 的设计需求

These observations yield three design requirements:

AgentAtlas~\cite{agentatlas} argues that outcome leaderboards miss
trajectory-level quality.

structured signals from traces, but both characterize \emph{input
distributions} rather than \emph{resource attribution}, because
labels at the request level do not propagate to downstream tool calls
and system effects.
% Datadog LLM Observability~\cite{datadog-llmobs} 按主题聚类用户消息，Laminar~\cite{laminar-signals} 从 trace 中提取结构化信号，但两者都刻画输入分布而非资源归因，因为请求级的标签不会传播到下游工具调用和系统副作用。

% TELBench~\cite{telbench} 构建 span 定位基准。

trajectory-level quality.
% AgentAtlas~\cite{agentatlas} 认为结果排行榜忽略了轨迹级质量。

trajectory anomalies.

within a single execution, while \sys performs category-level
aggregate profiling across trajectories.
% 这些系统在单次执行内执行 span 级或步骤级故障定位，而 \sys 执行跨轨迹的类别级聚合 profiling。

79	%% ¶1: Background + context
80	AI agents~\cite{sweagent,claudecode,osworld} orchestrate multi-step activities that span two layers, high-level intent (prompts, LLM calls, tool invocations) and low-level system effects (process spawns, file and network I/O).
81	% AI 智能体~\cite{sweagent,claudecode,osworld}编排跨越两层的多步骤活动：高层意图（提示词、LLM 调用、工具调用）和低层系统副作用（进程创建、文件和网络 I/O）。
82	As agents evolve from short, scripted workflows into complex systems that run for hours and days, with a large number of interactions each, production teams accumulate many such trajectories over weeks or months.
83	% 随着智能体从短小的脚本化工作流进化为每次运行数小时、包含数千次交互的复杂系统，生产团队在数周或数月内积累大量此类轨迹。
84	
85	%% ¶2: Problem
86	To improve agent quality, safety, and cost efficiency, developers
87	need to analyze operational behavior across trajectories and
88	interactions.
89	Which categories of tasks consume the most token budget? Where do
90	failures concentrate across workflows? Which behavioral patterns
91	trigger unsafe system effects?
92	% 为了提高智能体质量、安全性和成本效率，开发者需要跨轨迹和交互分析运维行为。哪类任务消耗最多 token 预算？故障跨工作流集中在哪里？哪些行为模式触发不安全系统副作用？
93	Answering these questions requires analysis and evaluation across many
94	trajectories~\cite{agentatlas,agentrewardbench}, a task becoming costly for manual inspection or
95	per-trajectory LLM evaluation~\cite{llm-as-judge} at scale.
96	% 回答这些问题需要跨许多轨迹的分析和评估，在规模化时人工检查或逐轨迹 LLM 评估的成本越来越高。
97	In traditional systems software, profiling answers these questions by
98	attributing resource consumption to responsible entities by
99	aggregation, as distinct from single-execution debugging and tracing.
100	% 在传统系统软件中，profiling 通过聚合将资源消耗归因到负责实体来回答这些问题，区别于单次执行调试和 tracing。
101	
102	%% ¶3: Existing solutions
103	Yet existing agent tools support debugging and tracing but not
104	profiling.
105	% 然而现有智能体工具支持调试和 tracing，但不支持 profiling。
106	LangSmith~\cite{langsmith}, Langfuse~\cite{langfuse},
107	Phoenix~\cite{phoenix}, and OpenTelemetry GenAI~\cite{otel} organize
108	events into per-session span trees, effective for diagnosing a single
109	run but unable to aggregate by semantic category.
110	% LangSmith~\cite{langsmith}、Langfuse~\cite{langfuse}、Phoenix~\cite{phoenix} 和 OpenTelemetry GenAI~\cite{otel} 将事件组织为按会话的 span 树，有效诊断单次运行但无法按语义类别跨会话聚合。
111	Datadog LLM Observability~\cite{datadog-llmobs} clusters user
112	messages by topic, and Laminar~\cite{laminar-signals} extracts
113	structured signals from traces, but both characterize \emph{input
114	distributions} (``30\% of users ask code questions'') rather than
115	\emph{resource attribution} (``review tasks consume 40\% of the
116	token budget''), because labels at the request level do not propagate
117	to downstream tool calls and system effects.
118	% Datadog LLM Observability~\cite{datadog-llmobs} 按主题聚类用户消息，Laminar~\cite{laminar-signals} 从 trace 中提取结构化信号，但两者都刻画输入分布（"30\% 的用户提问代码问题"）而非资源归因（"review 任务消耗了 40\% 的 token 预算"），因为请求级的标签不会传播到下游工具调用和系统副作用。
119	
120	%% ¶4: Challenge — why traditional profiling doesn't transfer directly
121	Adapting profiling to agent trajectories is challenging
122	(\S\ref{sec:background}).
123	% 将 profiling 适配到智能体轨迹具有挑战性（\S\ref{sec:background}）。
124	In traditional software, the responsible entities are code paths.
125	Profiling is straightforward because function names are
126	deterministic and runtime call nesting provides the aggregation
127	hierarchy, and flame graphs~\cite{flamegraphs}, pprof~\cite{pprof}, and Perfetto~\cite{perfetto} visualize the result.
128	% 在传统软件中，负责实体是代码路径。Profiling 是直接的，因为函数名是确定性的，运行时调用嵌套提供聚合层次，火焰图~\cite{flamegraphs}可视化其结果。
129	Agent behavior differs fundamentally.
130	To answer the questions above, the responsible entities need to be
131	semantic categories such as task intent and tool operation, not code
132	paths.
133	% 智能体行为有根本不同。要回答上述问题，负责实体需要是语义类别（如任务意图和工具操作），而非代码路径。
134	Agent trajectories also lack the two properties that make aggregation possible.
135	% 智能体轨迹还缺乏使聚合成为可能的两个特性。
136	Prompts are natural language, and two prompts expressing the same intent share no common string.
137	% 提示词是自然语言，表达相同意图的两个提示词没有共同字符串。
138	Framework-level span names (\texttt{LLMCall}, \texttt{ToolInvoke}) describe mechanisms, not semantic intent.
139	% 框架级 span 名称（\texttt{LLMCall}、\texttt{ToolInvoke}）描述机制，而非语义意图。
140	Agent events have no runtime call-stack hierarchy because prompts,
141	tool calls, and system effects are not nested by execution the way
142	function calls produce stack frames.

content.content:
244	\subsection{LLMs and AI Agents}
245	% AI 智能体
246	
247	A typical agent trajectory interleaves two layers of activity.
248	% 典型的智能体轨迹交织两层活动。
249	At the intent layer, the agent receives a user prompt, issues LLM
250	calls, and invokes tools (code execution, web search, file editing).
251	% 在意图层，智能体接收用户提示词、发出 LLM 调用并调用工具（代码执行、网络搜索、文件编辑）。
252	Each tool invocation triggers system effects at the lower layer:
253	process spawns, file reads and writes, and network requests.
254	% 每次工具调用在下层触发系统副作用：进程创建、文件读写和网络请求。
255	A single trajectory may contain hundreds of such intent-effect
256	cycles, and a production team accumulates many trajectories over
257	time.
258	% 单条轨迹可能包含数百个这样的意图-副作用循环，生产团队随时间积累许多轨迹。
259	
260	\subsection{System Profiling}
261	% 系统 Profiling
262	
263	Profiling attributes resource consumption to responsible entities by
264	aggregation, as distinct from single-execution debugging and
265	tracing.
266	% Profiling 通过聚合将资源消耗归因到负责实体，区别于单次执行调试和 tracing。
267	In traditional software, the profiling pipeline works as follows:
268	a profiler periodically samples execution state, attaches each
269	sample to the current call stack, and merges samples with identical
270	stacks.
271	% 在传统软件中，profiling 管线如下工作：profiler 周期性采样执行状态，将每个样本附加到当前调用栈，合并具有相同栈的样本。
272	Flame graphs~\cite{flamegraphs} and pprof~\cite{pprof} call graphs
273	visualize the result, where width or node size represents aggregate
274	cost.
275	% 火焰图~\cite{flamegraphs}和 pprof~\cite{pprof} 调用图可视化其结果，宽度或节点大小代表聚合开销。
276	Perfetto~\cite{perfetto} generalizes this with SQL-based analysis
277	and derived events.
278	% Perfetto~\cite{perfetto} 通过基于 SQL 的分析和衍生事件进行泛化。
279	These tools support flexible aggregation, but they all assume
280	deterministic function names and a runtime call stack.
281	% 这些工具支持灵活聚合，但都假设确定性函数名和运行时调用栈。
282	Pprof's \texttt{tagroot}/\texttt{tagleaf} options can add
283	label-derived pseudo-frames, but only on top of an existing execution
284	stack that agent trajectories do not have.
285	% Pprof 的 \texttt{tagroot}/\texttt{tagleaf} 选项可以添加标签衍生的伪帧，但仅在智能体轨迹不具备的已有执行栈之上。
286	
287	\subsection{The Aggregation Gap for Agents}
288	% 智能体的聚合缺口
289	
290	Existing tools~\cite{langsmith,langfuse,phoenix,otel} record agent
291	events as per-execution span trees, effective for debugging a single
292	run.
293	% 现有工具~\cite{langsmith,langfuse,phoenix,otel}将智能体事件记录为按执行划分的 span 树，有效调试单次运行。
294	AgentSight~\cite{agentsight} bridges intent and system-effect layers
295	by correlating eBPF-captured system events with intercepted LLM
296	traffic, but the resulting traces still lack aggregate profiling.
297	% AgentSight~\cite{agentsight} 通过关联 eBPF 捕获的系统事件与拦截的 LLM 流量来桥接意图层和系统副作用层，但生成的 trace 仍缺乏聚合分析能力。
298	None of these tools provides cross-trajectory resource attribution
299	by semantic category, and this creates three concrete gaps.

\subsection{LLMs and AI Agents}
% AI 智能体

A typical agent trajectory interleaves two layers of activity.
% 典型的智能体轨迹交织两层活动。
At the intent layer, the agent receives a user prompt, issues LLM
calls, and invokes tools (code execution, web search, file editing).
% 在意图层，智能体接收用户提示词、发出 LLM 调用并调用工具（代码执行、网络搜索、文件编辑）。
Each tool invocation triggers system effects at the lower layer:
process spawns, file reads and writes, and network requests.
% 每次工具调用在下层触发系统副作用：进程创建、文件读写和网络请求。
A single trajectory may contain hundreds of such intent-effect
cycles, and a production team accumulates many trajectories over
time.
% 单条轨迹可能包含数百个这样的意图-副作用循环，生产团队随时间积累许多轨迹。

\subsection{System Profiling}
% 系统 Profiling

Profiling attributes resource consumption to responsible entities by
aggregation, as distinct from single-execution debugging and
tracing.
% Profiling 通过聚合将资源消耗归因到负责实体，区别于单次执行调试和 tracing。
In traditional software, the profiling pipeline works as follows:
a profiler periodically samples execution state, attaches each
sample to the current call stack, and merges samples with identical
stacks.
% 在传统软件中，profiling 管线如下工作：profiler 周期性采样执行状态，将每个样本附加到当前调用栈，合并具有相同栈的样本。
Flame graphs~\cite{flamegraphs} and pprof~\cite{pprof} call graphs
visualize the result, where width or node size represents aggregate
cost.
% 火焰图~\cite{flamegraphs}和 pprof~\cite{pprof} 调用图可视化其结果，宽度或节点大小代表聚合开销。
Perfetto~\cite{perfetto} generalizes this with SQL-based analysis
and derived events.
% Perfetto~\cite{perfetto} 通过基于 SQL 的分析和衍生事件进行泛化。
These tools support flexible aggregation, but they all assume
deterministic function names and a runtime call stack.
% 这些工具支持灵活聚合，但都假设确定性函数名和运行时调用栈。
Pprof's \texttt{tagroot}/\texttt{tagleaf} options can add
label-derived pseudo-frames, but only on top of an existing execution
stack that agent trajectories do not have.
% Pprof 的 \texttt{tagroot}/\texttt{tagleaf} 选项可以添加标签衍生的伪帧，但仅在智能体轨迹不具备的已有执行栈之上。

\subsection{The Aggregation Gap for Agents}
% 智能体的聚合缺口

Existing tools~\cite{langsmith,langfuse,phoenix,otel} record agent
events as per-execution span trees, effective for debugging a single
run.
% 现有工具~\cite{langsmith,langfuse,phoenix,otel}将智能体事件记录为按执行划分的 span 树，有效调试单次运行。
AgentSight~\cite{agentsight} bridges intent and system-effect layers
by correlating eBPF-captured system events with intercepted LLM
traffic, but the resulting traces still lack aggregate profiling.
% AgentSight~\cite{agentsight} 通过关联 eBPF 捕获的系统事件与拦截的 LLM 流量来桥接意图层和系统副作用层，但生成的 trace 仍缺乏聚合分析能力。
None of these tools provides cross-trajectory resource attribution
by semantic category, and this creates three concrete gaps.
% 这些工具都不提供按语义类别的跨轨迹资源归因，这造成了三个具体缺口。

First, sessions are boundaries, not categories.
% 第一，会话是边界，不是类别。
A single session may contain review, debugging, and refactoring phases, and splitting by session assigns all of them to the same bucket.
% 单个会话可能包含 review、debugging 和 refactoring 阶段，按会话拆分会将它们全部分配到同一桶中。
Two sessions performing the same task produce separate buckets that cannot be merged without external logic.
% 执行相同任务的两个会话会产生无法在没有外部逻辑的情况下合并的分离桶。

Second, span names~\cite{otel,openinference} describe mechanisms (\texttt{LLMCall}, \texttt{ToolInvoke}, \texttt{ChatCompletion}), not user intent (\texttt{review}, \texttt{debug}, \texttt{test}).
% 第二，span 名称~\cite{otel,openinference}描述机制（\texttt{LLMCall}、\texttt{ToolInvoke}、\texttt{ChatCompletion}），而非用户意图（\texttt{review}、\texttt{debug}、\texttt{test}）。
Grouping by span name tells you how many LLM calls occurred, not which categories of work consumed the budget.
% 按 span 名称分组只能告诉你发生了多少次 LLM 调用，而非哪些工作类别消耗了预算。

Third, these limitations compound in practice.
% 第三，这些限制在实践中叠加放大。
A common system effect like running a test suite may appear thousands of times across sessions, but a flat summary shows only a single counter with no way to attribute executions to the semantic intent that triggered them.
% 像运行测试套件这样的常见系统副作用可能在会话中出现数千次，但扁平摘要只显示一个计数器，无法将执行归因到触发它们的语义意图。
We quantify this in RQ1~(\S\ref{sec:eval}).
% 我们在 RQ1~(\S\ref{sec:eval}) 中量化了这一点。

\subsection{Design Requirements for Agent Profiling}
% 智能体 Profiling 的设计需求

These observations yield three design requirements:
% 这些观察得出三个设计需求：

\begin{description}
\item[R1: Uniform record type.]
Agent activities mix prompts, LLM calls, tool invocations, GUI actions, process events, and benchmark labels.
% 智能体活动混合了提示词、LLM 调用、工具调用、GUI 操作、进程事件和基准标签。
The profiler needs a single record type that can represent all of them without type-specific objects.
% 分析器需要一种能表示所有这些活动的单一记录类型，无需特定类型的对象。
\item[R2: Query-time aggregation.]

with pluggable intent attribution and stack construction, pro-
ducing pprof-compatible output (§4).
(3) Hidden-label evaluation. We evaluate profiler output against
hidden ground-truth trajectory labels, analogous to injecting
known bottlenecks in CPU profiler evaluation, on 325 real
sessions and 4 public datasets (§5).
2 Background and Motivation
2.1 AI Agent Observability
As introduced in §1, agent activities span both intent and system-
effect layers. Existing observability tools [4, 9] cover these lay-
ers separately. LangSmith [14], Langfuse [15], Phoenix [2], and
OpenTelemetry GenAI [25] organize agent-level events into per-
execution span trees. System monitors show process and file activity
without semantic attribution. The span-tree design is effective for
debugging. A developer can locate a failing span, inspect its at-
tributes, and trace its parent chain. AgentSight [37] bridges the two
layers by correlating eBPF-captured system events with intercepted
LLM traffic, but the resulting traces still lack aggregate profiling.
2.2 Profiling vs. Debugging
Debugging inspects a single execution, but profiling aggregates
across executions to answer questions like “where does the budget
go?” CPU profilers solved this aggregation problem decades ago.
A flame graph [12] represents a profile as weighted samples, each
attached to a call stack. Identical stacks merge, and width represents
aggregate cost. The key enabler is deterministic function names, so
the same code path always produces the same frames.
Agent activities break this precondition in two ways. First, prompts
are natural language and lack deterministic identifiers. Second,
agent events have no inherent call stack because they lack the
runtime-determined parent-child nesting that function calls provide.
Pprof’s [11] tagroot/tagleaf options add label-derived pseudo-
frames to an existing execution stack, but agent activities have no
execution stack to augment.
2.3 The Aggregation Gap
Existing agent observability tools [2, 7, 14, 15, 25] are designed for
debugging, not profiling, and this creates three concrete gaps.
First, sessions are boundaries, not categories. A single session
may contain review, debugging, and refactoring phases, and split-
ting by session assigns all of them to the same bucket. Two sessions
performing the same task produce separate buckets that cannot be
merged without external logic.
Second, span names [3, 25] describe mechanisms (LLMCall, ToolInvoke,
ChatCompletion), not user intent (review, debug, test). Grouping
by span name tells you how many LLM calls occurred, not which
categories of work consumed the budget.
Third, these limitations compound in practice. A common system
effect like running a test suite may appear thousands of times across
sessions, but a flat summary shows only a single counter with no
way to attribute executions to the semantic intent that triggered
them. We quantify this in RQ1 (§5).
These observations yield three design requirements:
R1: Uniform record type. Agent activities mix prompts, LLM
calls, tool invocations, GUI actions, process events, and bench-
mark labels. The profiler needs a single record type that can
represent all of them without type-specific objects.
